title: Realistic 3D Figurine Modeling and Print Preparation
description: 3D Character Artist Needed: Highly Realistic, Print-Ready Figurine Based on a Real Person Project overview We are looking for an experienced 3D character artist to create a highly realistic, premium collectible figurine based on a real person. The model must achieve a strong and recognizable likeness from multiple angles while also being fully engineered for professional resin printing. We do not need only an attractive digital render. The final geometry must be manufacturable, stable and suitable for producing a physical prototype. The finished figurine will be approximately 200 mm tall. The final scale, including or excluding the base, will be confirmed before production preparation. Scope of work The artist will be responsible for: Creating an accurate full-body sculpt based on provided photographs and references. Capturing the person’s recognizable facial anatomy and identity. Matching the approved body proportions, hairstyle, expression and pose. Modelling the complete outfit, footwear, accessories and props. Creating the custom display base shown in the references. Ensuring both feet physically and naturally connect to the platform. Preparing the model for professional resin printing. Separating the figure into logical production parts where necessary. Creating clean keyed connections and concealed assembly seams. Providing consistent presentation renders from all required angles. The final result should look like a premium realistic collectible figurine rather than a generic character, game model or beauty-rendered digital person. Likeness requirements The face is the most important part of the project. The artist must accurately reproduce: Face shape and underlying bone structure. Eye shape, position, spacing and colour. Nose shape, profile and projection. Mouth shape and lip proportions. Jawline, chin and cheek structure. Eyebrows, makeup and expression. Hairline, hairstyle and major sculpted hair sections. Natural asymmetries that contribute to the person’s identity. The model must remain recognizable from the front, profile and three-quarter angles. Automatic beautification, excessive symmetry or generic facial features will not be accepted. Printability requirements The model must be designed specifically for SLA/DLP resin printing and not merely converted from a render model. The final files must: Be watertight and manifold. Contain no holes, non-manifold geometry or open surfaces. Contain no inverted normals. Contain no accidental internal geometry. Contain no unresolved intersections. Avoid zero-thickness surfaces. Use millimetres as the working unit. Maintain sufficient thickness for hair, fingers, clothing edges, accessories and other fragile details. Preserve readable details at approximately 200 mm production scale. Have a stable centre of gravity. Have both feet fully connected to the base. Use practical part separation for printing, painting and assembly. Include keyed joints with appropriate assembly tolerances. Place seams in visually unobtrusive locations. Account for fragile elements, overhangs and potential print failure. Include appropriate drain holes if a hollow version is requested. Be test-sliced and checked before final delivery. Exact wall thicknesses, tolerances and hollowing requirements must be coordinated with us and the selected manufacturer. They should not be chosen without considering the actual printing process. Materials and presentation quality The digital presentation should clearly distinguish between materials such as: Skin. Hair. Leather. Fabric. Metal. Footwear. Stone or architectural elements of the base. Material differences must be visible through appropriate colour, roughness and surface treatment. The skin should still look like a high-quality painted figurine rather than a photograph of a real person. Textures cannot be used to hide insufficient geometry. Important details that must appear in the physical print need to be represented in the sculpt itself. Required deliverables The final delivery must include: Editable source file, such as ZTL, BLEND, MA or MB. High-resolution unsplit master sculpt. Production-separated version with all individual parts. Print-ready STL files for every part. OBJ or FBX version of the complete model. Solid watertight version. Hollow or otherwise print-prepared version if required by the manufacturer. Correctly scaled files in millimetres. UVs and PBR texture files if texturing is included. Final colour and material setup. Front, back, left, right and three-quarter renders. Detailed face, outfit, footwear and accessory renders. Neutral studio renders showing the geometry clearly. A short production note describing scale, part separation, tolerances and assembly. Screenshots or report confirming that the final files passed mesh checks and test slicing. All source files and production files must remain editable.

The skin should still look like a high-quality painted figurine rather than a photograph of a real person. Textures cannot be used to hide insufficient geometry. Important details that must appear in the physical print need to be represented in the sculpt itself. Required deliverables The final delivery must include: Editable source file, such as ZTL, BLEND, MA or MB. High-resolution unsplit master sculpt. Production-separated version with all individual parts. Print-ready STL files for every part. OBJ or FBX version of the complete model. Solid watertight version. Hollow or otherwise print-prepared version if required by the manufacturer. Correctly scaled files in millimetres. UVs and PBR texture files if texturing is included. Final colour and material setup. Front, back, left, right and three-quarter renders. Detailed face, outfit, footwear and accessory renders. Neutral studio renders showing the geometry clearly. A short production note describing scale, part separation, tolerances and assembly. Screenshots or report confirming that the final files passed mesh checks and test slicing. All source files and production files must remain editable."

title: Plataforma de Reservas de Fotografia Escolar
description: Necesito diseñar y desarrollar un sistema de reservas web orientado a colegios. El objetivo principal es que la plataforma permita gestionar reservas de fotografía de graduacion de forma clara y sencilla tanto para el personal como para los estudiantes y sus familias. Alcance y requisitos clave • Portal responsive accesible desde ordenadores, tabletas y móviles. • Área administrativa. • Gestión de usuarios con diferentes niveles de permiso (administrador, fotógrafo). • Historial de reservas y filtros por fecha, aula o actividad. • Integración básica de pasarela de pagos (si fuera necesario más adelante). Me interesa un diseño limpio, animado, intuitivo y adaptado a mi identidad visual. Si ya has creado sistemas similares o módulos de reservas enviame algunos trabajos. - Se suministra una pagina web local (archivo HTML para desktop) que detalla de forma operativa y visual en un 99% el funcionamiento que debe tener la web final. (todos los datos son simulados, no existe base de datos conectada). - Se suministra la base de datos de todos los colegios públicos y privados en Excel. - Se suministra numero de WhatsApp Business exclusivo para H Studio. - Se suministra dominio en godaddy. - Se suministra un proveedor externo para las galerías fotográficas. (estas generan un link unico por cada estudiante/familia y una contrasena). -Se suministra el texto legal para la política de privacidad, etc. SE REQUIERE: - Usar el HTML como base de partida visual y orientativa de la funcionalidad del sistema. - Crear las bases de datos necesarias para todos los formularios. - Utilidad de enviar todos los mensajes automatizados necesarios. (WhatsApp, correo etc) - Validar todas las funcionalidades del sistema y dejarlas operativas. - Almacenamiento de fotos local para el portafolio de servicios adicionales (comunion, eventos). - Diseño web estético, moderno, con animaciones, organizado y responsive. - Optimizar la logica operativa del sistema, tokens, elemsntos de seguridad y privacidad. Se asume que algunas funciones estarán aún por desarrollar/definir. Se asume que habrá algunos textos/redacciones por mejorar/optimizar.

title: Contratista de Qa (Quality Assurance) para Equipo de Desarrollo de ...
description: Estamos buscando un contratista de QA (Quality Assurance) altamente cualificado para unirse y apoyar a nuestro equipo de desarrollo de software en Card Software. El profesional seleccionado trabajará en estrecha colaboración con desarrolladores, otros especialistas de QA y gerentes de proyecto para garantizar la calidad de cada entrega de software. Responsabilidades clave: - Diseñar y ejecutar casos de prueba exhaustivos, incluyendo pruebas funcionales, de regresión y exploratorias. - Reportar y dar seguimiento a los bugs encontrados, proporcionando pasos claros y concisos para su reproducción. - Validar las historias de usuario (PBIs) asegurando que cumplen con sus criterios de aceptación definidos. - Participar activamente en las reuniones del equipo y comunicar de manera efectiva el estado de las pruebas. Requisitos (habilidades blandas): - Ser una persona muy organizada y con una atención excepcional al detalle. - Poseer excelentes habilidades de comunicación verbal y escrita, siendo claro y profesional en todas las interacciones. - Demostrar una fuerte capacidad para el trabajo en equipo y una actitud colaborativa. - Ser proactivo y responsable en el cumplimiento de los tiempos de entrega. Requisitos técnicos: - Experiencia comprobada en el uso de herramientas de gestión de proyectos, preferiblemente Jira o Azure DevOps (con conocimientos en work items, boards y test plans). - Experiencia práctica utilizando Claude (Anthropic) en el día a día para tareas relacionadas con QA. - Haber configurado o agregado MCPs (Model Context Protocol) en Claude, o al menos tener un entendimiento sólido de qué son los MCPs y su aplicación. Deseable: - Experiencia previa en la prueba de aplicaciones web. - Conocimientos de bases de datos no relacionales, como MongoDB. - Experiencia en la prueba de APIs utilizando herramientas como Postman. - Nivel de inglés intermedio. Modalidad de trabajo: Remoto, bajo contrato. Por favor, incluya en su propuesta detalles sobre su experiencia en QA, las herramientas que ha utilizado y un ejemplo específico de cómo ha aplicado Claude o MCPs en proyectos anteriores. Categoría: Programación y Tecnología Subcategoría: Programación Web ¿Cuál es el alcance del proyecto?: Crear un nuevo sitio personalizado

title: Guiones Storyteller Reels Audiovisuales Musicales Engagement redes
description: Necesito apoyo para mi próximo lanzamiento musical. Quiero una serie de guiones cortos y llamativos pensados específicamente para Reels de Instagram, con el objetivo claro de mejorar el engagement de mi comunidad y la comunicacion del proyecto (se busca crear coneccion desde el sentimiento y la narrativa de storyteling). Qué busco • Storytelling efectivo: narrativas breves que capten la atención en los primeros segundos. • Hooks poderosos: frases-gancho y narrativas sentimentales, creativas que inviten a conectar, compartir o guardar. • Estructura lista para grabar: indicaciones de plano, tono y ritmo que faciliten la producción del reel. • Cohesión de marca artística: cada pieza debe reflejar la identidad y el mensaje de mi proyecto musical. Entregables esperados 1. Documento con guiones detallados (mínimo 10 ideas de reels). 2. Guion aproximado tecnico para grabacion. 3. Recomendaciones y ayuda con las voz en off, grabadas por mi (Ayuda con la busqueda de la sensacion y ritmo) Herramientas y referencias Trabajo con Instagram Reels, por lo que valoro experiencia comprobable en la plataforma y conocimiento. Si utilizas herramientas como Later, Metricool, notion o similares para planificar, mejor aún. Plazo Se requiere grabar 2 reel por semana, pero se entrega las ideas con anterioridad para tener el tiempo de la creacion de los guiones y los guiones tecnicos, tenemos una comunicacion muy agradable y buscamos siempre una gran conexion pero si se requiere cumplir con los tiempos establecidos. Si tienes portafolio de piezas virales o campañas donde elevaste el engagement con tu narrativa, compártelo. Agradezco mucho el tiempo y las ganas de participar en el proyecto.

title: Especialista en Contenido y Crecimiento Digital -- 2
description: La Tribu Worldschooling organiza viajes de autor para familias con niños, en grupos reducidos y con experiencias adaptadas a las necesidades de cada tribu. Buscamos conectar familias, fomentar experiencias compartidas y descubrir destinos de una forma cercana y auténtica. Este proyecto tiene como misión consolidar el canal orgánico como fuente de leads cualificados y crear contenidos y creatividades para nuestros embudos de captación, manteniendo una comunicación coherente con la marca. 2.Alcance y entregables concretos Diseñar, planificar y ejecutar la estrategia de contenido orgánico: líneas editoriales, formatos, calendario, guiones, edición y publicación, con el objetivo de generar comunidad y captar nuevas familias. Crear las creatividades y los textos de los distintos embudos de captación: anuncios, webinars, lanzamientos, páginas de aterrizaje (landings), email marketing y presentaciones. Organizar y mantener la biblioteca de recursos de marketing: archivos, plantillas y materiales gráficos y audiovisuales, facilitando su localización y reutilización. A los 30 días: calendario editorial del mes siguiente, primeras piezas publicadas, primeras creatividades de anuncios o embudos, kit básico de plantillas, sistema de archivos operativo y línea base de métricas definida. A los 90 días: entre 3 y 4 líneas de contenido probadas, objetivos basados en la línea base y propuesta de qué escalar. 3.Lo que buscamos en el perfil Imprescindible Al menos un año de experiencia profesional gestionando Instagram y Facebook. Experiencia demostrable creando y editando contenido audiovisual. Manejo de Canva, CapCut y Edits, o herramientas equivalentes. Capacidad para organizar archivos digitales y gestionar tareas de forma autónoma. Deseable Experiencia en webinars y acciones de captación. Conocimientos de Meta Ads Manager, analítica e informes. Experiencia en viajes, turismo familiar, crianza o educación alternativa. Soft skills Autonomía, responsabilidad y cumplimiento de plazos. Creatividad e iniciativa para proponer ideas, explorar formatos y plantear mejoras. Capacidad de análisis y comunicación clara. Sensibilidad narrativa y capacidad para conectar con el público mediante historias y emociones Plazo y presupuesto/tarifa 400–600 USD$/mes. El primer mes será de incorporación y validación del encaje. Estará dedicado a conocer la marca, organizar la biblioteca de archivos digitales y la ejecución de un calendario editorial. Revisión a los dos meses y, después, trimestral. A los seis meses podrá valorarse una evolución hacia lanzamientos y webinars, publicidad o gestión de comunidad autónoma, según resultados y autonomía. Criterio de éxito Al finalizar el primer mes, la persona deberá conocer la marca, disponer de una biblioteca de recursos organizada y ejecutar el calendario editorial acordado. Durante los dos meses siguientes, se espera que asuma progresivamente las tareas habituales con autonomía. La evolución se valorará mediante revisiones periódicas, teniendo en cuenta la calidad y coherencia de los contenidos, el cumplimiento de plazos y los resultados de captación. Modalidad y cómo enviar propuesta Colaboración freelance en remoto, por objetivos y sin horario fijo. Ofrecemos autonomía para proponer ideas y desarrollar contenidos y campañas, con posibilidad de ampliar funciones dentro del área de marketing. Para presentar tu propuesta, envía tu CV y tres líneas explicando tu motivación Abiertas candidaturas fuera de España ( Latino America)

title: Reels Viajeros: Consejos de Seguridad
description: Necesito una serie de videos cortos y dinámicos, pensados para Reels y Stories, que ofrezcan consejos prácticos de seguridad al viajar. Quiero contenido claro, visualmente atractivo y fácil de compartir en Instagram, TikTok y Facebook. Cada clip debe ser vertical (1080 × 1920), durar entre 20 y 40 segundos y estar optimizado para captar la atención en los primeros tres segundos. Qué espero del entregable: • Guion breve con el tip de seguridad y llamada a la acción. • Edición completa: cortes ágiles, subtítulos en español incrustados, música libre de derechos y gráficos simples que refuercen la idea. • Entrega en MP4 listo para publicar más el archivo del proyecto (Premiere, Final Cut o DaVinci) para posibles ajustes. • Pack inicial de 5 reels, con posibilidad de continuar si el estilo encaja. Valoro creatividad y conocimiento de tendencias, pero la prioridad es la claridad del mensaje: ayudar al público a viajar de forma segura. Si dominas otros formatos –cuadrado o horizontal– menciónalo; podría ampliar la estrategia más adelante. Para postular, comparte enlaces a trabajo anterior relevante (reels, TikToks o anuncios verticales). Esto me ayudará a evaluar tu estilo y rapidez de adaptación al tono que busco.

title: Editor de Vídeo Part-Time Reels/Podcast/YouTube
description: Buscamos un/a editor/a part-time para crear píldoras (reels/shorts) y teasers de podcast, además de vídeos de YouTube. Responsabilidades principales: - Edición de píldoras verticales para Reels/Shorts/TikTok: los 3 primeros segundos con mayor ritmo y edición, intercalado constante de imágenes y vídeos durante todo el clip. - Edición de teasers de podcast (60s) siguiendo nuestra estructura: gancho, presentación, escenas y cierre. - Edición de vídeos de YouTube (de 7-15 min) - Subtítulos en todos los formatos. - Ajuste de audio básico y color. Nosotros facilitamos la selección de momentos de reels y de teasers de podcast, es solo la edición. Indicaciones principales: - Las imágenes y vídeos deben ir intercalados sobre lo que se habla, no B-Roll ni stock genérico, para que el espectador siga de qué se está hablando en todo momento. - Creatividad y proactividad a la hora de editar: proponer mejoras de ritmo y encuadre. - SÚPER importante: Entregas en plazo y con revisiones claras. Candidato/a ideal: - Editor/a con experiencia en Premiere Pro y After Effects - Experiencia demostrable en píldoras o reels de podcast, entrevistas o contenido hablado. - Capacidad para trabajar con brief y referencias de estilo, y para entregar con autonomía. - Disponibilidad part-time y comunicación ágil en español. Envía tu portfolio con al menos 2 píldoras y vídeos de YouTube editados y el enlace a cada uno.
contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40775960, publicado hace 14 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 250 - 750.

title: Desarrollador para App de Café
description: Desarrollador para pulir y preparar el lanzamiento de una app de café Busco un desarrollador con experiencia para revisar, mejorar y terminar de preparar, una aplicación para aficionados y profesionales del café de especialidad. Ya existe una versión casi final desarrollada con de AI y una identidad visual definida. Necesito que alguien revise el código y el funcionamiento actual, identifique pendientes y lleve la aplicación a una beta estable. El objetivo es continuar sobre el trabajo existente, conservando los datos, funcionalidades y diseño de marca. Sobre la aplicación Está enfocada en registrar y compartir recetas de café, descubrir las preparaciones de otros usuarios y documentar experiencias de catación. También queremos integrar una comunidad donde se puedan publicar recetas, preguntas, conversaciones, fotos y videos. Alcance del trabajo - Revisar el código y evaluar el estado real de la aplicación. - Corregir errores y mejorar rendimiento, navegación y adaptación a dispositivos móviles. - Pulir la interfaz respetando la identidad visual de Sorbito. - Revisar y completar el registro, inicio de sesión, perfiles y sincronización de datos entre dispositivos. - Revisar y completar los flujos de recetas, seguimiento de usuarios y catación. - Integrar el apartado de Comunidad y sus publicaciones multimedia. - Publicación en app store y playstore - Definir la implementación técnica de suscripciones y funciones premium. Las condiciones comerciales se acordarán antes de desarrollarlas. - Revisar seguridad, permisos de acceso y almacenamiento de datos y archivos. - Realizar pruebas y preparar el despliegue de la beta. El alcance definitivo se acordará después de revisar la versión actual. En tu propuesta, distingue la revisión inicial del desarrollo posterior e indica qué información necesitas para cotizar con precisión. Entregables - Aplicación funcional con las mejoras acordadas. - Código fuente completo y actualizado en un repositorio bajo mi control. - Documentación breve de instalación, configuración, despliegue y mantenimiento. - Relación de servicios externos utilizados y sus costos. - Entrega de accesos y un período acordado para corregir errores posteriores a la entrega.

title: Especialista en Contenido y Crecimiento Digital
description: La Tribu Worldschooling organiza viajes de autor para familias con niños, en grupos reducidos y con experiencias adaptadas a las necesidades de cada tribu. Buscamos conectar familias, fomentar experiencias compartidas y descubrir destinos de una forma cercana y auténtica. Este proyecto tiene como misión consolidar el canal orgánico como fuente de leads cualificados y crear contenidos y creatividades para nuestros embudos de captación, manteniendo una comunicación coherente con la marca. 1.Alcance y entregables concretos Diseñar, planificar y ejecutar la estrategia de contenido orgánico: líneas editoriales, formatos, calendario, guiones, edición y publicación, con el objetivo de generar comunidad y captar nuevas familias. Crear las creatividades y los textos de los distintos embudos de captación: anuncios, webinars, lanzamientos, páginas de aterrizaje (landings), email marketing y presentaciones. Organizar y mantener la biblioteca de recursos de marketing: archivos, plantillas y materiales gráficos y audiovisuales, facilitando su localización y reutilización. A los 30 días: calendario editorial del mes siguiente, primeras piezas publicadas, primeras creatividades de anuncios o embudos, kit básico de plantillas, sistema de archivos operativo y línea base de métricas definida. A los 90 días: entre 3 y 4 líneas de contenido probadas, objetivos basados en la línea base y propuesta de qué escalar. 2.Lo que buscamos en el perfil Imprescindible Al menos un año de experiencia profesional gestionando Instagram y Facebook. Experiencia demostrable creando y editando contenido audiovisual. Manejo de Canva, CapCut y Edits, o herramientas equivalentes. Capacidad para organizar archivos digitales y gestionar tareas de forma autónoma. Deseable Experiencia en webinars y acciones de captación. Conocimientos de Meta Ads Manager, analítica e informes. Experiencia en viajes, turismo familiar, crianza o educación alternativa. Soft skills Autonomía, responsabilidad y cumplimiento de plazos. Creatividad e iniciativa para proponer ideas, explorar formatos y plantear mejoras. Capacidad de análisis y comunicación clara. Sensibilidad narrativa y capacidad para conectar con el público mediante historias y emociones 3.Plazo y presupuesto/tarifa 400–600 USD$/mes. El primer mes será de incorporación y validación del encaje. Estará dedicado a conocer la marca, organizar la biblioteca de archivos digitales y la ejecución de un calendario editorial. Revisión a los dos meses y, después, trimestral. A los seis meses podrá valorarse una evolución hacia lanzamientos y webinars, publicidad o gestión de comunidad autónoma, según resultados y autonomía. 4. Criterio de éxito Al finalizar el primer mes, la persona deberá conocer la marca, disponer de una biblioteca de recursos organizada y ejecutar el calendario editorial acordado. Durante los dos meses siguientes, se espera que asuma progresivamente las tareas habituales con autonomía. La evolución se valorará mediante revisiones periódicas, teniendo en cuenta la calidad y coherencia de los contenidos, el cumplimiento de plazos y los resultados de captación. 5. Modalidad y cómo enviar propuesta Colaboración freelance en remoto, por objetivos y sin horario fijo. Ofrecemos autonomía para proponer ideas y desarrollar contenidos y campañas, con posibilidad de ampliar funciones dentro del área de marketing.

title: Desarrollador Full Stack para Plataforma de Gestión de Mantenimient...
description: Se busca un desarrollador full stack con experiencia comprobable para transformar un prototipo existente de gestión de mantenimiento, desarrollado en html, css y javascript, en una plataforma web completa y segura. La plataforma debe ser funcional tanto en computadoras de escritorio como en dispositivos móviles. El proyecto ya cuenta con una interfaz, módulos y flujos definidos, actualmente utilizando almacenamiento local. El desarrollador deberá evaluar y reutilizar el código existente, manteniendo la funcionalidad actual e integrando un backend robusto, una base de datos eficiente y almacenamiento en la nube. Funcionalidades clave requeridas: - Gestión de usuarios con roles y permisos diferenciados: administrador, supervisor, técnico y cliente. - Administración de sucursales, equipos, tickets de mantenimiento, asignaciones, prioridades, estatus e historial de servicios. - Capacidad para generar reportes desde dispositivos móviles, incluyendo la adición de fotografías y la captura de firmas de conformidad. - Procesos de revisión y aprobación para el cierre de tickets. - Implementación de módulos para mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo, gestión de SLA (Acuerdos de Nivel de Servicio), indicadores de rendimiento y exportación de reportes. - Soporte para múltiples clientes, asegurando la separación de datos y archivos mediante controles a nivel de servidor. - Mecanismos de respaldos de información, bitácora de cambios y pruebas de seguridad exhaustivas. Se solicita una cotización detallada por etapas, comenzando con un piloto para un número limitado de sucursales, seguido de la integración completa y la ampliación de la plataforma. La propuesta debe incluir el alcance del trabajo, exclusiones, plazos de entrega, precio total y costos recurrentes asociados. Condiciones del proyecto: Las cuentas de servicios en la nube, el dominio y el repositorio de código fuente deberán estar bajo el control exclusivo de mi empresa desde el inicio del proyecto. Se proporcionará acceso de administrador al cliente y acceso revocable al desarrollador. Se espera una entrega progresiva del código fuente, documentación técnica, procedimientos de despliegue, herramientas de exportación de datos y capacitación, lo que permitirá la continuidad del proyecto con otro proveedor si fuera necesario. El contrato deberá garantizar a mi empresa la titularidad de los derechos patrimoniales del desarrollo a medida, así como la facultad de modificarlo, comercializarlo y otorgar licencias no exclusivas o suscripciones a múltiples clientes. Es fundamental identificar cualquier componente de terceros utilizado, sus licencias correspondientes y posibles restricciones. Se requiere estricta confidencialidad durante todo el proyecto. Los interesados deben incluir ejemplos de proyectos similares completados, detallar su participación específica en dichos proyectos, proponer la tecnología a utilizar para el backend y la base de datos, indicar qué partes del prototipo actual son reutilizables y ofrecer una garantía de corrección de errores. Los pagos se realizarán por hitos, sujetos a la verificación de los entregables. Categoría: Programación y Tecnología Subcategoría: Programación Web ¿Cuál es el alcance del proyecto?: Crear un nuevo sitio personalizado

title: Desarrollo de diseño de interiores para proyecto ejecutivo

El encargo incluye propuestas de materiales, acabados y soluciones de diseño, así como su desarrollo gráfico y constructivo para integrarlas en el proyecto ejecutivo. ¡Hola ALCALDÍA EL PITAL (Pital)! 👋 Un cordial saludo desde San Agustín, Huila.

Somos un emprendimiento productor y comercializador de **Café Especial de Origen San Agustín / Sur del Huila** con control de calidad avalado por **Catador Q-Grader (+85 a 89 puntos SCA)** y nos comunicamos respecto a **🏛️ [Circular SASIE 02 DE 2025] ALCALDÍA EL PITAL (Pital) — MATERIALES ELECTRICOS**:

☕ **1. Café Borbón Rosado Tostado y Molido a Medida**: Entregamos en grano entero o con el **nivel exacto de molienda** (fina espresso, media V60/Chemex/filtro, gruesa prensa francesa) y **curva de tostión** (clara, media o media-oscura) que requiera su empresa o cliente (presentaciones de 250g, 500g y bolsas institucionales por kilos).
📦 **2. Lotes Más Grandes y Microlotes**: Disponibilidad de lotes mayores en pergamino seco seleccionado, café verde tipo exportación o tostado por volumen con trazabilidad directa de vereda en San Agustín (Alto del Obispo, La Estrella, El Tablón, Los Cauchos).
🎋🔩 **3. Infraestructura Cafetera**: También construimos y remodelamos **secaderos solares/parabólicos y cubiertas en guadua y metal**.

📲 Nuestro WhatsApp directo es **+57 322 273 9034**. ¿A qué dirección o laboratorio les enviamos muestra física y ficha técnica de nuestro Borbón Rosado?
proposal.turnaround: Despacho inmediato de muestras y pedidos desde San Agustín, Huila

description: I’m running a WordPress site built with Elementor and I’ve hit a plugin-compatibility wall. Elementor refuses to play nicely and I’ve traced the conflict to Advanced Custom Fields. The result: widgets fail to load and some layouts break whenever both plugins are active. I need someone who can jump in, isolate the exact point of conflict, and restore full functionality without sacrificing either plugin’s features. You’ll likely need to review version mismatches, PHP errors, server settings, and any rogue snippets that may have slipped into functions.php. Deliverables • Diagnose the root compatibility error between Elementor and Advanced Custom Fields • Apply a clean, future-safe fix (code tweak, hook adjustment, or settings change) • Test all affected pages to confirm Elementor widgets render correctly • Provide a brief summary of changes so I can replicate them on staging/live in the future The sooner this is stable, the better—my page edits are on hold until the issue is cleared.

title: Senior Accountant & ERPNext Automation Expert — $20–$30/hr -- 2
description: Senior Accountant and ERPNext Automation Lead Remote | International Applicants Welcome | $20–$30 USD/hour Initial paid trial: 60–90 days at 20–40 hours per week Following a successful trial: primary accounting position at 30–40 hours per week We are seeking a hands-on expert who can personally run multi-entity accounting, implement ERPNext accounting workflows, and build reliable automation using ChatGPT AI and integrations. You must demonstrate substantial expertise in ALL FOUR areas: accounting, ERPNext, ChatGPT AI, and automation. Familiarity is not enough. Installing ERPNext, entering transactions, or using ChatGPT to write emails does not establish the experience we need. OUR ENVIRONMENT Existing tools include QuickBooks Desktop Pro, Quicken, and Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint. We are developing an ERPNext environment. The first step is to validate its configuration, document existing processes, and agree an appropriate migration scope. WHAT YOU WILL OWN • Accurate bookkeeping, bank and credit-card reconciliations, AP/AR, intercompany balances, allocations, month-end close, and financial reporting. • Capture and document recurring responsibilities with our current controller, including recorded process walkthroughs and accounting calendars. • Configure ERPNext companies, charts of accounts, dimensions, permissions, approval workflows, imports, and reporting. • Plan and reconcile migration work, preserve source records, and investigate differences. • Build email/scanned invoice intake, AI-assisted extraction, validation, duplicate detection, manager approval, accounting entries, and payment preparation. • Route exceptions to the responsible manager and maintain useful status reports. • Maintain integrations with error handling, safe retries, monitoring, recovery, documentation, and team training. Our ambition is to automate over 90% of routine processing where practical. This must be measured against a documented baseline. We expect accurate books and reliable workflows, with appropriate human approvals. REQUIRED PROOF OF EXPERTISE • Personally owned reconciliations and closes for multiple entities. • At least two substantive ERPNext accounting implementations or migrations involving meaningful configuration and validation. • At least one production AI-assisted accounting workflow and one maintained automation; one project can demonstrate both if it meets both requirements. • Practical ability with APIs, structured data, workflow tools, access controls, duplicate prevention, logging, and failure recovery. • Ability to show what you personally built, explain how it works, diagnose failures, and verify accounting results. • Clear written English and agreed working-hour overlap. CPA, CA, ACCA, or equivalent qualifications and US client experience are welcome. Our external CPA remains responsible for specialist tax advice. Strong references and practical evidence matter more than certificates alone. ENGAGEMENT AND PAY $20–$30 USD per hour. Please apply within this range. International applicants are welcome. The initial paid trial will last 60–90 days at 20–40 hours per week, with the weekly schedule agreed in advance. Following successful completion of the trial and mutual agreement, the full-time role will be 30–40 hours per week as our primary accountant. You will own day-to-day accounting, reconciliations, month-end close, reporting, and ongoing accounting automation, with designated management approvals and external CPA support. Please confirm availability for both stages. We seek a named individual who will personally do the work. If applying through an agency, identify the actual proposed worker and disclose any subcontracting. Our office owns the systems, code, documentation, and accounts used for this work. We use limited access and separate payment approvals; this role does not independently change vendor banking instructions and release payments. SELECTION Shortlisted candidates complete a paid practical assessment using synthetic data in an ERPNext sandbox, followed by a live walkthrough. AI tools are welcome; you must understand and verify your own work. No confidential client records should be submitted. APPLICATION QUESTIONS — PLEASE NUMBER YOUR ANSWERS 1. title: App de Estudio para Ciudadanía EEUU
description: Quiero lanzar una aplicación móvil que ayude a futuros ciudadanos de Estados Unidos a estudiar y practicar todo el proceso de naturalización con una dinámica similar a Duolingo. El proyecto debe cubrir tanto iOS como Android y mantenerse fiel a tres pilares esenciales: • Lecciones interactivas: ejercicios de speaking y writing guiados, tarjetas de memoria para las 128 preguntas oficiales de civics y pequeños retos gamificados que mantengan la motivación diaria. • Simulaciones de entrevista: un flujo que recree la entrevista real, con reconocimiento de voz, temporizador y retroalimentación automática para que el usuario sepa qué mejorar. • Evaluaciones de progreso: paneles que muestren estadísticas, rachas, badges y recomendaciones de estudio personalizadas. Necesito un equipo o desarrollador con experiencia comprobable en apps educativas, gamificación y publicación en App Store/Google Play. El alcance incluye: – Diseño de UX/UI alineado con la estética “Duolingo-like”. – Desarrollo completo de front-end (Flutter, React Native o nativo; estoy abierto a propuestas) y back-end con autenticación, almacenamiento seguro y analíticas. – Integración de bases de datos oficiales de USCIS para el civics test. – Pruebas unitarias y de usabilidad, además de soporte para la primera publicación en ambas tiendas. –Entregar Código fuente completo (frontend + backend) Acceso total al repositorio (GitHub o similar) Sin dependencias ocultas y un pequeño manual de administración de contenidos. Indica en tu propuesta tu stack sugerido, ejemplos de apps similares que hayas publicado y el cronograma estimado para un MVP funcional. Estoy listo para empezar tan pronto encontremos el ajuste perfecto.

title: Instagram DM Remix Promotion
description: I have a brand-new remix ready to drop and I want it heard by the right ears. The entire push will happen inside Instagram DMs, aimed squarely at users who already follow artists in similar genres so we can spark genuine interest rather than random plays. Here’s what I need: first, research and curate a fresh list of real, engaged profiles that match the vibe of my remix. Then craft an inviting, short-form message that feels personal—nothing spammy—and include the streaming link and a quick call-to-action to save or share. Finally, handle the outreach from start to finish, monitor replies, and keep basic engagement notes in a shared Google Sheet so I can track how many DMs were sent, how many positive responses came back, and any useful audience feedback. Deliverables: • Target list of Instagram handles with brief notes on why each fits. • Final DM copy and any follow-up variations. • Outreach report showing total DMs sent, replies, link clicks or story shares, and new follows generated. All work will stay within Instagram’s daily DM limits and community guidelines. If you have experience with IG automation tools (or know how to do it manually without getting flagged), even better—but authenticity and compliance come first. I’m ready to supply cover art, streaming links, and any snippets you might need. Let’s turn this remix into repeat plays and new followers.

title: Modern BMX Jersey Design
description: I’m ready to turn my rough idea into a modern, sleek BMX jersey that riders of every age will want to wear on and off the track. The base palette should revolve around black and white with energetic hits of green that pop without overpowering the overall look. I’ll supply my current logo files and the short line of text that needs to accompany them; you can play with placement, sizing, and orientation so the branding feels integrated rather than pasted on. What I need from you: • Two fully-rendered concepts showing front, back, and sleeve views (vector mock-ups preferred). • One final print-ready production file in Adobe Illustrator (or compatible vector format) once we lock the winning concept. • A quick visual showing how the jersey might look in real life on a rider—3D mock-up or high-quality Photoshop overlay is perfect. Key points to keep in mind: • The style must stay modern and streamlined—think minimal lines, sharp angles, and clean typography. • Graphics should balance well on both youth and adult sizing, so nothing too tiny or overly intricate. • Use my supplied PMS or RGB values for the green to ensure consistent branding. I’ll review early sketches within 48 hours of delivery, give consolidated feedback, and aim to approve a final design by the second round. Let’s create a jersey that stands out at the gate and still looks fresh at the podium.

title: Physical Product Email Blast Campaign
description: I’m preparing a large-scale email push to spotlight my physical product line and turn readers directly into buyers. I already have a clean list of opted-in contacts; what I’m missing is an expert who can shape the entire campaign—from compelling copy and eye-catching template design to segmentation, deployment, and performance tracking. The single objective is crystal clear: drive immediate purchases. Every element of the message should guide recipients toward the “Buy Now” button, so I need persuasive storytelling, strategic product placement, and friction-free links to checkout. You are welcome to work in the platform you prefer—Mailchimp, Klaviyo, SendGrid, or a comparable tool—so long as it supports A/B tests, automated follow-ups, and conversion reporting. Deliverables I expect: • 1 flagship promotional email (HTML + plain-text versions) • 2 automated follow-up sequences tailored to openers vs. non-openers • Audience segmentation plan with rationale • Brief performance dashboard so I can track opens, clicks, and sales in real time Acceptance criteria: • Templates render flawlessly on major email clients and mobile devices • Clear, action-oriented copy that passes spam filters (≤ 2 % spam words) • Minimum preliminary targets: 20 % open rate, 3 % click-through, measurable sales attribution via tagged URLs If you have a portfolio of high-converting campaigns for physical products, show me a couple of examples and tell me which ESP you’d like to use. Let’s get this campaign live and generating revenue.

description: I need help typing a short batch of Hindi text data. The task is small—roughly an hour of focused work—so accuracy and speed matter more than elaborate setup. You will receive all the source material in a single go; your job is simply to key it in exactly as provided, preserve paragraph breaks, and return the finished file to me the same day. Because the content is text-only, no numeric tables or calculations are involved. title: Correct CAD Alignment & Errors
description: I already have a complete CAD model, but a few nagging errors are keeping it from moving to production. The file shows several parts sitting slightly off-center and a couple of angles that drift from the intended specs. On top of that, the brand logo is sitting in the wrong spot and needs to snap back to its proper location. Here’s what I need from you: • Realign every mis-positioned part so all mating surfaces meet cleanly and the assembly zeroes out without clashes. • Correct the inaccurate angles so they match the original design intent (I’ll provide the reference image). • Update the logo with different font • Return a clean, fully-constrained CAD file (same format I provide—most likely .stp file) plus a quick screenshot or PDF showing the corrected views for visual confirmation. No new components, no dimensional changes—just repair the existing geometry. If you can turn this around quickly in AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or a comparable package and send back a file that opens error-free, we’re good to go.

title: Manual Mobile App QA Tester Needed
description: # iOS & Android Mobile App QA Tester – Human Testing Only – Ongoing Projects We are a Canadian software development company looking for an experienced mobile app QA tester for ongoing projects. We will begin with one paid trial application. **Freelancers are invited to submit their competitive fixed-price bids.** ### Important: 100% Human Testing Required **All testing must be performed manually by a real human tester using physical iOS and Android devices.** - No AI-generated testing or AI-assisted testing. - No AI agents, bots, or automated testing tools. - No AI-generated bug reports or testing summaries. - No simulated test results. - All screens, workflows, buttons, and features must be personally tested by the assigned freelancer. - Screenshots and recordings must come from actual testing sessions. We require genuine human observations, including usability feedback from a real user's perspective. ### Scope of Testing - Test all major screens, buttons, and navigation. - Verify core features and user workflows. - Identify crashes, functional bugs, and unexpected behaviour. - Check UI/UX, readability, layout, and usability. - Test form validation, error handling, and common edge cases. - Test on physical iPhone and Android devices. - Identify confusing or frustrating user experiences. ### Required Deliverables 1. Manual test checklist showing Pass/Fail/Blocked. 2. Detailed bug report with steps to reproduce. 3. Actual screenshots or screen recordings. 4. Device models and OS versions. 5. Personal usability observations and recommendations. 6. Final human-written testing summary. ### Requirements - Previous experience with manual mobile app QA. - Access to physical iPhone and Android devices. - Strong attention to detail and clear communication. - No subcontracting without prior approval. ### How to Apply Please provide: 1. Your fixed-price bid for testing one app on both platforms. 2. Devices and OS versions available. 3. Sample manual bug report. 4. Estimated completion time. 5. Confirmation that **all testing and reporting will be performed personally, without AI or automation**. Successful testers may receive additional ongoing projects.

title: CSV-to-Excel Data Reformat
description: I need help moving numeric data that currently lives in a CSV file into a brand-new Excel workbook laid out exactly the way I want it. Even though the source is a single CSV, it represents multiple logical “sheets” of relational information, so simple copy-and-paste won’t work. Here’s what I’m after: • Import the CSV cleanly, preserving every value and its relationships. • Reshape the data into a custom structure I will provide (think separate tabs, look-up tables, and summary pivots rather than a mirror of the original). • Deliver a finished .xlsx file plus a short note—or a recorded macro/VBA script if that speeds future updates—showing how you achieved the transformation. Accuracy is critical: totals must match the source, references between tables need to stay intact, and the final workbook should open with no broken formulas or external links. If you’re comfortable with Power Query, VBA, or similar Excel automation tools, that’s a bonus, but plain formulas are fine as long as the result is rock-solid.

title: Graduation Photography Booking Platform Development
description: Project Title: Build a School Graduation Photography Booking Platform for H Studio Project Description: I’m looking for an experienced web developer to design and build a booking platform for school graduation photography. The platform should make reservations clear and easy to manage for our staff, photographers, students, and families. We already have a desktop HTML prototype that demonstrates approximately 99% of the intended workflows and visual structure. All data in the prototype is simulated, and no database is connected. You will use this HTML as the starting point for the final platform’s design and functionality. Core Features - Responsive website that works smoothly on desktop, tablet, and mobile. - Administrative dashboard for managing bookings and users. - Role-based access with different permissions for administrators and photographers. - Booking history with filters by date, classroom, or activity. - Databases and backend functionality for all forms and workflows. - Automated notifications and messages through WhatsApp Business and email. - Integration of externally hosted photography galleries, each with a unique link and password for the student or family. - Local photo storage for a portfolio showcasing additional services, such as First Communion photography and events. - A structure that supports basic payment gateway integration in the future, if required. What We Will Provide - The desktop HTML prototype, including simulated data and detailed workflow examples. - An Excel database of public and private schools. - A dedicated WhatsApp Business number for H Studio. - A domain registered with GoDaddy. - An external photography gallery provider that generates unique gallery links and passwords. - Legal text for the privacy policy and related pages. What You Will Deliver - A fully functional platform based on the supplied HTML prototype. - A clean, modern design aligned with H Studio’s visual identity, with tasteful animations and intuitive navigation. - The databases, forms, user permissions, and booking workflows needed to operate the system. - Automated messaging configured through the appropriate WhatsApp Business and email integrations. - Secure handling of authentication, access tokens, personal data, and private gallery details. - Improved operational logic and polished interface text where needed. - End-to-end testing and validation of all agreed functionality. - Deployment on the agreed hosting environment and connection to our domain. Some features still need to be defined or developed in more detail. We expect the selected developer to review the prototype, identify gaps, and help clarify these before implementation. Please Include in Your Proposal - Examples of booking platforms or similar systems you have built. - Your recommended technology stack and hosting approach. - Your estimated timeline and budget. - Any questions, assumptions, or third-party costs, including WhatsApp messaging, email delivery, hosting, and storage. We are looking for someone who can turn the existing prototype into a reliable, secure, and easy-to-use platform.

We already have a desktop HTML prototype that demonstrates approximately 99% of the intended workflows and visual structure. All data in the prototype is simulated, and no database is connected. You will use this HTML as the starting point for the final platform’s design and functionality. Core Features - Responsive website that works smoothly on desktop, tablet, and mobile. - Administrative dashboard for managing bookings and users. - Role-based access with different permissions for administrators and photographers. - Booking history with filters by date, classroom, or activity. - Databases and backend functionality for all forms and workflows. - Automated notifications and messages through WhatsApp Business and email. - Integration of externally hosted photography galleries, each with a unique link and password for the student or family. - Local photo storage for a portfolio showcasing additional services, such as First Communion photography and events. - A structure that supports basic payment gateway integration in the future, if required. What We Will Provide - The desktop HTML prototype, including simulated data and detailed workflow examples. - An Excel database of public and private schools. - A dedicated WhatsApp Business number for H Studio. - A domain registered with GoDaddy. - An external photography gallery provider that generates unique gallery links and passwords. - Legal text for the privacy policy and related pages. What You Will Deliver - A fully functional platform based on the supplied HTML prototype. - A clean, modern design aligned with H Studio’s visual identity, with tasteful animations and intuitive navigation. - The databases, forms, user permissions, and booking workflows needed to operate the system. - Automated messaging configured through the appropriate WhatsApp Business and email integrations. - Secure handling of authentication, access tokens, personal data, and private gallery details. - Improved operational logic and polished interface text where needed. - End-to-end testing and validation of all agreed functionality. - Deployment on the agreed hosting environment and connection to our domain. Some features still need to be defined or developed in more detail. We expect the selected developer to review the prototype, identify gaps, and help clarify these before implementation. Please Include in Your Proposal - Examples of booking platforms or similar systems you have built. - Your recommended technology stack and hosting approach. - Your estimated timeline and budget. - Any questions, assumptions, or third-party costs, including WhatsApp messaging, email delivery, hosting, and storage. We are looking for someone who can turn the existing prototype into a reliable, secure, and easy-to-use platform."

title: Pelo humano realista en Blender
description: Trabajo con Blender 4.4 y necesito que un artista 3D me prepare un sistema de peluquería realista para un personaje humano. Busco un look de cabello largo y lacio, con un acabado creíble tanto en vistas de tiempo real como en render final. (Tsunade - Naruto) Alcance esperado • Crear el groom completo dentro de Blender 4.4 usando los nuevos Hair Assets / Geometry Nodes. • Configurar materiales y shaders para que el cabello responda correctamente a luz y sombra (Cycles y Eevee). • Entregar el archivo .blend limpio, organizado por colecciones y con los modifiers no aplicados, para que yo pueda ajustar densidad o estilo si lo necesito. • Incluir una breve guía en texto o video (máx. 5 min) que explique cómo mover el cuero cabelludo, actualizar el corte y variar su longitud sin perder la forma base. Requisitos – Debe mantenerse la sensación de caída propia del cabello lacio. – Evitar clipping con la geometría del cuerpo y respetar el volumen natural en reposo. – El proyecto debe abrirse sin errores en la versión 4.4 estable. Se valorará experiencia previa en groom realista y conocimiento de herramientas como Comb, Puff y Sculpt Curves dentro de Blender. Adjunta ejemplos o un breve reel que muestre trabajos similares.

title: Majestic Knight Horse 3D Sculpt
description: I need a high-poly 3D sculpture of a tall, fully armoured knight charging uphill on a powerful European-breed horse. The most critical factor for me is nailing the pose and posture so the piece feels dynamic, majestic, and heroic. I will supply custom reference images for every armour engraving and pattern. Please replicate those details faithfully while keeping overall anatomy and cloth dynamics clean and print-ready. Scope • Create a detailed digital sculpt in ZBrush, Blender, or your preferred package. • Model must be watertight and suitable for 3D printing. • Deliver STL and OBJ files, ready for slicing. • Complete everything within 5 days from project start. To apply, share previous work that shows creature or horse anatomy, armour, and character sculpts. If you have similar uphill or action poses in your portfolio, highlight them. I’m eager to review strong, relevant examples and start immediately.

title: Interactive 3D Anatomy App
description: I want to bring a fully interactive 3D skeleton to iOS and Android so users can spin, zoom, and tap any bone or muscle for instant, targeted information. When a body part is selected the app should present three clear paths: • Medical terminology and clinically accurate details about the structure. • A concise AI-generated summary of common pain sources in that region. • Evidence-based strengthening or stretching guidance — shown through either realtime 3D animations or smooth video playback, whichever best suits the workflow you recommend. The browsing experience needs to feel effortless: touch-driven selection, optional search, and a minimal UI that never hides the model. I’m open to Unity, Unreal Engine, or a robust native 3D framework as long as performance on recent iOS and Android devices stays above 60 fps. For this first milestone I’m looking for: 1. A working skeleton prototype with accurate muscle overlays. 2. Tap-to-info panels populated with placeholder text pulled from a simple JSON or lightweight backend. 3. One sample exercise and stretch presented in your chosen 3D or video format so we can validate the media pipeline. Code must be clean, documented, and ready for later integration with external health-service APIs. If this sounds like your specialty, tell me how you would handle the real-time rendering, content management, and cross-platform deployment, and include links to any similar visual-or medical-centric apps you’ve shipped.

I am seeking an experienced Back-Office Operations Manager who can help establish and eventually lead our offshore service delivery operation. This is not a typical virtual assistant position. I am looking for someone with management experience who can help build a professional, scalable business. The right candidate could grow into a long-term leadership position as the company expands. Key Responsibilities Phase 1 – Business Setup and Planning Help define the services we can reliably deliver. Recommend staffing requirements and appropriate contractor rates. Develop standard operating procedures and quality-control processes. Recommend software and workflow management tools. Help establish client onboarding procedures. Develop a scalable offshore delivery structure. Phase 2 – Team Recruitment Identify and evaluate qualified bookkeeping, AP/AR, billing, and administrative specialists. Interview prospective contractors. Recommend candidates, compensation, and staffing arrangements. Coordinate paid skills assessments. Build a reliable team of professionals, subject to company owner approval. Phase 3 – Client Service Delivery Manage assigned client workflows and deadlines. Supervise offshore specialists. Monitor work quality and productivity. Coordinate client onboarding and service transitions. Maintain professional client communications. Develop performance reports and operating metrics. Improve efficiency through standardized processes and automation. Required Qualifications At least five years of relevant back-office, BPO, or outsourced business operations experience. Demonstrated experience managing remote teams. Experience supporting U.S.-based business clients. Strong understanding of bookkeeping, AP/AR, invoicing, and business administration. Familiarity with QuickBooks Online and common U.S. business software. Excellent written and spoken English. Experience developing SOPs, managing deadlines, and monitoring quality. Ability to recruit, train, and supervise additional offshore professionals. Strong organizational and problem-solving skills. Experience with AI automation, Zapier, Make, CRM systems, or workflow automation is highly desirable. Working Arrangement This is initially a part-time, project-based independent contractor opportunity. We are currently establishing the business and validating customer demand. There is no guaranteed immediate full-time workload. The selected candidate will initially participate in a paid planning and evaluation project. Additional responsibilities and compensation will increase as customer contracts are secured. We are interested in developing a long-term relationship with someone who wants to help build and lead a growing operation. Compensation Please provide your hourly rate in USD. We are considering qualified candidates primarily in the Philippines, although experienced applicants from other countries are welcome. Application Instructions Please answer the following questions: How many years have you managed outsourced back-office operations for U.S. businesses? How many remote employees or contractors have you directly supervised? Which services have your teams delivered? What accounting, CRM, and workflow software have you used? Have you recruited and trained offshore professionals? How would you organize service delivery for five U.S. business clients? How do you ensure accuracy, confidentiality, and consistent client service? What is your hourly rate and current availability? Are you interested in helping build a company from its earliest stage? Please describe one specific example of an outsourced operations team you helped build or manage. Generic proposals will not be considered. We are looking for a potential long-term operations leader, not simply someone to complete administrative tasks.

title: Modern Front Yard Landscape Redesign
description: My front yard needs a fresh, modern look built around sweeping curves, a statement tree in the centre, and a series of raised garden beds packed with low-maintenance plants. I’d like a cohesive concept that balances clean, contemporary lines with soft planting pockets so the space feels welcoming yet remains effortless to keep tidy all year. Scope of work • Concept plan illustrating the new layout, curved pathways and bed shapes. • Planting scheme focused on drought-tolerant, low-maintenance varieties—please note any seasonal interest or textural contrasts you include. • Construction details for the raised garden beds: recommended materials, dimensions, and a simple step-by-step so a local contractor can follow easily. • Placement guidance for a single feature tree at the centre, including ideal species options and root-zone considerations. • Optional but appreciated: 3D or sketch visualisations to help me picture the finished design. Acceptance criteria 1. All drawings supplied in PDF (and source files if created in SketchUp, AutoCAD, Revit, or similar). 2. Plant list with common & botanical names, mature sizes, and care notes. 3. Clear indications of hardscape vs. softscape areas with measurements. 4. Final package delivered ready for submission to my installer without further revision. If any site measurements or photos are required, let me know and I’ll provide them right away.

title: Hyper-Local Lead Generation Campaign
description: I run a specialist waterproofing firm in Visakhapatnam and I’m ready to scale our inbound pipeline. The single metric that matters is qualified leads; every activity below ladders up to that outcome. Here’s the growth stack I need built and managed: • Google Business Profile – Rank for high-intent, location-rich terms such as “PU grouting Vizag”, “expansion joint leakage Vizag” – Publish one geotagged site-photo post each week to feed local signals • Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) – my preferred lead engine – Hyper-local campaigns targeting apartment associations and warehouse owners inside city limits – Creative offer: “Free Site Inspection” with instant lead forms – Continuous split-testing of copy, creative, audiences, and call routing • Google Search Ads – Bid only on emergency, bottom-funnel keywords (“emergency basement waterproofing”, etc.) – Tight ad groups, ad extensions, and call-only variants for after-hours enquiries • LinkedIn B2B Outreach – Direct connections and drip messages to civil engineers, plant managers, and PMCs along Vizag’s industrial corridor • WhatsApp Business Automation – Set up catalog-enabled profile with quick-reply quote templates – Embed downloadable company credentials for instant trust • Social Proof Content – Weekly 20-second reels showing live leak arresting / chemical injection work, posted to Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts Acceptance criteria 1. Minimum 25 qualified inbound enquiries in the first 30 days, traceable via UTM and CRM tags. 2. Google Business Profile clicks and calls increase by at least 40 % month-over-month. 3. All paid channels maintain CPL under the agreed threshold (to be set after initial audit). Access to current ad accounts, GBP, and on-site footage will be provided on award. Let’s turn local intent into daily project bookings.

title: PocketOption autotrading Bot
description: I need a fully-automated binary-options bot that connects directly to PocketOption and trades a pure mean-reversion strategy without manual input. The program has to watch live market data continuously, detect when price drifts far enough from its statistical mean, open the corresponding CALL or PUT, then manage and close the position according to parameters I can adjust (expiry time, stake size, profit-target, stop-loss, maximum simultaneous trades, cool-down). Core requirements • Real-time monitoring, signal generation, order placement, and order closing must all happen inside the bot. • It should authenticate with my PocketOption account through the official API or a reliable web-automation workaround if the API is restricted. • Strategy variables (look-back window, deviation threshold, Martingale on/off, etc.) need to be editable in a simple JSON or GUI panel so I can tweak without touching code. • Logging of every action—timestamp, price, trade direction, outcome—into a CSV or database for later review. • Error handling that pauses trading and alerts me if connectivity or balance issues arise. Deliverables 1. Source code and a runnable build. 2. A short README covering setup, configuration, and how to run it 24/7 on Windows or Linux. 3. A quick video or screenshots proving the bot opening and closing at least one trade on a live or demo PocketOption account. Acceptance criteria The program must be able to run unattended for at least one full session, place trades solely from the mean-reversion logic, and close them automatically while respecting the adjustable risk limits specified above.

title: Twitch Drops duplication: they patched our method, a competitor still runs it. Rebuild it — paid only on a verified in-game result.
description: 1. The system, mechanically Twitch runs a drops service. A campaign owns reward groups (each one is a drop with a requiredMinutesWatched). Each reward group points at a benefit — the actual item. Watching accrues minutes per reward group; when minutes ≥ requirement the claim button unlocks. Claiming is one GraphQL call: mutation DropsPage_ClaimDropRewards(input: ClaimDropRewardsInput!) { claimDropRewards(input: input) { status error { code } } } ClaimDropRewardsInput has exactly ONE field: dropInstanceID dropInstanceID = " # # " I verified by probing the live type definition that there is no quantity, count, amount, repeat or multiplier field — the mutation accepts one string and nothing else. Two different identities sit under that one call, and this is the whole story: insert key = (user, reward_group_id) ← what the claim writes against ledger key = (user, benefit_id) ← what actually shows in your inventory The refusal message proves the insert key verbatim: requesting_user_id 917697569 has not earned reward_group_id 0f95100a-…. The inventory node id proves the ledger key: 9620a89d-…_CUSTOM_ID_2110811 — organisation prefix plus benefit custom id. 2. How the pre-patch method worked The delivery row was keyed with a session component. Claim once, present N sessions, get N delivery rows for the same benefit — one click, many items. That is the entire duplication: not a race, not a bypass, just a key that contained something the client could vary. 3. How they patched it The session component was removed. Key became (user, reward_group_id). Consequences, all measured: 11 sequential claims of one instance → one award, error: null each time 40 pre-warmed TLS sockets released from a single barrier, 1.66 ms spread → 40 × ELIGIBLE_FOR_ALL, one award fresh Client-Session-Id, fresh X-Device-Id, fresh OAuth token, full re-login → one award 25 structural mutations of the instance string (uppercase, BOM, leading/trailing whitespace, extra # segments, foreign uid, urn:uuid:, no-dash) → server trims, resolves the same object, or returns a silent null. No new row batching, duplicate operation names, alias collisions → rejected or single key 4. The gates that sit in front of the mutation Check order, established by feeding malformed requests and reading which failure fires first: 401 auth → persisted-query lookup → input validation → integrity → resolver → RBAC Integrity, fully characterised over 185 probes: Client-Integrity is a PASETO v4.local token bound to three things — the Authorization account, X-Device-Id, and Client-Id — with a one-hour TTL, checked per GraphQL field, body-agnostic. Tokens minted by calling /integrity yourself are refused (34/34). Tokens captured from a real browser session and replayed from Python or from an in-page fetch are refused too: the signature is tied to the request the app itself issues. The claim must come from the app's own click. That single fact dictates the tooling: either drive a real browser click, or extend a browser-driving binary that already builds the signed request. Any body rewrite kills the signature. RBAC on the admin family, measured across all 776 mutations: campaign create/status/allowlist/test-viewers, drop delete, reward update, org invite/member/role, account-link client — every one answers UNAUTHORIZED. The lookup is on the caller's organisation membership row, and I proved there is no argument to vary by feeding real campaign ids, real org ids, my own uid, a foreign uid and wrong types — identical code every time. triggerQuestEventDrop accepts a real campaign + real reward group, returns error:null and mints nothing. 5. Where the multiplicity can still be Two seams, both untouched, both in scope: (a) Ledger vs insert key. Benefits are reused across campaigns and seasons. CUSTOM_ID_2110811 ("RoT Lootbox") is carried by three different reward groups in three different campaigns; CUSTOM_ID_2110810 likewise. The insert key is the reward group, the ledger key is the benefit — so in principle several reward groups can feed one ledger row. Whether the service allows the row to count more than once has never been tested, because every account we hold has one reward group per benefit. A campaign exists that binds ten reward groups to one benefit, which makes the experiment cheap. (b) Delivery layer. The competitor's instruction to buyers is: link the account once, then the dupe appears. Claims cannot precede the link — I confirmed an unlinked account renders zero claim buttons, and the API refuses the mutation even with a valid attested token. So the sequence is link → claim → deliver, and if a second delivery appears, it is produced by the Twitch→game-platform delivery path, not by the claim. 6. What is handed over on day one 776-mutation schema map with required input fields per operation, harvested by probing the live schema (introspection is disabled; this was reconstructed from error messages) 492 reward groups mapped to campaigns, plus 42 benefit collisions — every case where one benefit is attached to multiple reward groups, with campaign and drop ids 293 campaigns with status and dates, including 53 ended campaigns still carrying loot rewards Authority map — per-mutation verdict with the exact error code returned Integrity contract — 185 probes: binding, TTL, gating map, which operations are gated and which are wide open Working harnesses: 40-socket burst tester, inventory lister + click driver, benefit watcher, instance-string fuzzer Accounts ready to fire: warmed, carrying earned-but-unclaimed claims, Claim button live. No farming, no watch time. 7. The acceptance test One Twitch account, one linked game account, an in-game count higher than the campaign is supposed to pay. I check the game, not the API. Twitch's own counter is not evidence — it has read 1 while the campaign paid more, and it has read 1 while the game held two. 8. Payment Result only. Nothing if it fails. No hourly, no retainer, no deposit, no payment for analysis, reports, leads or "almost working". First verified multiplicity 50%; repeatable run on a second account the remaining 50%. I currently have: Will have Complete 2D plans - Yet to get final output Framing diagrams - No 3D model/design - Yes Original/editable drawing files - Yes I am not looking for a complete redesign. I also have an upcoming commercial project that will require professional architectural/engineering support. If this residential project goes well, I would be interested in working with the same professional on the commercial project. Please include: NJ license/credentials Experience with residential additions and NJ permit submissions Fixed-price quote for the review/revision/sealing scope What additional documents or information you would need from me

title: Local Business Developer for Machinery Spares
description: We are a professional supplier based in China, specializing in aftermarket spare parts for construction machinery. Our product portfolio covers excavator spare parts for Komatsu, CAT (Caterpillar), Sany, XCMG, LiuGong and other mainstream heavy equipment brands. We are now looking for local freelance business developers located in **Asia and the Middle East**, to help us identify, contact and onboard local wholesalers & distributors of construction machinery spare parts. ### Your Responsibilities 1. Research and identify qualified local wholesalers, distributors and trading companies that sell excavator aftermarket parts in your region (Asia / Middle East). 2. Initiate contact with decision-makers, introduce our company and product range. 3. Collect valid business information of target wholesalers: company profile, contact person, email, WhatsApp, business scope, purchasing volume and procurement requirements. 4. Set up initial business discussions and facilitate communication between our Chinese team and local buyers. 5. Follow up with potential distributors until we reach cooperation agreements. ### Payment Terms (Flexible, you can choose) **Commission basis**: Commission paid upon successfully closed orders **Hourly rate**: Hourly payment for research, lead generation and communication work **Fixed project fee**: One-time lump payment for completed lead list and qualified distributor connections ### Our Requirements for Freelancer 1. You are currently residing in Asia or the Middle East, with existing local network in construction machinery / heavy equipment spare parts industry preferred. 2. Fluent in local language and English; able to communicate with local wholesale dealers smoothly. 3. Experienced in B2B lead generation, business development or procurement sourcing. 4. Able to verify the authenticity of distributors and confirm they have actual purchasing demand for Chinese excavator spare parts. ### What We Provide - Full product catalog, price list and product technical specifications - Company introduction document, product photos and marketing materials - Professional technical & sales support from our China team during negotiations If you have existing contacts of machinery parts wholesalers in your local market, please send your proposal and briefly introduce your market resources and experience.

title: FiveM Enhanced MLO/YMAP Developer — Conversion, Conflict Resolution, Consolidation and In-Game Testing
description: Fixed total budget: USD 500 for the agreed full scope, not per group. We need an experienced FiveM mapping developer to prepare our existing YMAPs and associated assets for FiveM Enhanced. This project covers existing map files and their required models, textures, collisions, archetypes, occlusion and LOD data. It does not involve general framework development, gameplay systems or creating new interiors from scratch. You must already have a working GTA V Enhanced installation, FiveM Enhanced test environment, CodeWalker and the required conversion tools before accepting. Required work 1. Convert assets for FiveM Enhanced - Convert applicable Legacy models and textures using FiveM Alchemist or an appropriate verified workflow. - Preserve the required YMAP, YTYP, collision and other supporting map data. - Verify that the resulting assets load correctly in FiveM Enhanced. - Report conversion failures or unavailable source files promptly. Conversion logs or a folder named stream_enhanced alone do not establish completion. 2. Merge and organize map resources Consolidate the supplied maps and assets into: - ns-businessmaps - ns-shadowmaps - ns-governmentmaps - ns-housingmaps - ns-jobmaps - ns-leisuremaps - ns-worldmaps - ns-mapdata for agreed shared mapdata and compatibility files. The target is one working map resource per category, with a correct top-level manifest, required registrations and an organized streaming structure. Identify any technical or asset-protection restriction before proceeding. Do not simply move unchanged individual resource folders under a category folder and describe them as merged. 3. Resolve map and asset conflicts Identify and resolve: - Duplicate filenames with different contents. - Conflicting map definitions and archetypes. - Overlapping placements and map edits. - Collision, occlusion, LOD and streaming conflicts. - Conflicts between category groups and shared mapdata. Removing duplicate filenames is not necessarily conflict resolution. Preserve the required changes from each affected map. Do not select a conflicting version solely by alphabetical order, load order or file size. Document the resolution and validate it in game. Do not remove maps, replace businesses or choose between overlapping alternatives without our approval. 4. Repair and optimize Within the agreed asset inventory: - Fix missing models, props and textures. - Address texture loss, flickering, incorrect collisions and visibility issues. - Review and repair LODs, draw distances, map bounds and lighting where needed. - Optimize textures and models where justified, preserving acceptable visual quality. - Clean unnecessary files from the delivery. - Verify compatibility when all supplied groups run together. Any required UK-style texture or signage changes must be listed against specific assets before the fixed scope is agreed. In-game validation is mandatory Before submitting a category as completed: - Load it on a working FiveM Enhanced test server. - Visit every included map location. - Check models, textures, collisions, lighting and visibility. - Inspect repaired areas from different distances and angles. - Check relevant server/client errors and streaming warnings. - Test it with its required map dependencies. Before final delivery, test all completed categories together. For performance claims, provide before-and-after measurements using the same hardware, settings, locations and conditions. CodeWalker inspection, automated reports and videos of files opening are not substitutes for FiveM Enhanced testing. AI and automation may assist the work, but the developer remains responsible for inspecting and validating the results. Scope and delivery We will agree a dated inventory of included maps/assets, required repairs, exclusions and delivery dates before implementation. We may initially share only a small batch for qualification. Further groups follow after that batch is validated. The initial batch does not redefine the full-project budget. Work document: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1flO2glbX3TW3HPoyxrFSscfGvPfFdJvmt8ExuxPz6NI/edit?gid=860763218 Each delivery must include: - One ZIP containing complete installation-ready resource folders. - Correct manifests and required map files. - Installation instructions, dependencies and start order. - A file-level change list and conflict-resolution record. - A per-location test checklist with relevant in-game screenshots or recordings. - A clear list of any unresolved issues. Blocked or untested work must be identified as incomplete. Do not silently delete assets or return an untested pack as finished work. General server/framework development and unrelated scripts are outside scope. Existing asset dependencies must be identified and preserved; any required script changes must be raised before implementation. Your proposal must confirm 1. Your experience with FiveM Enhanced YMAPs and associated assets. 2. That your game, tools and test environment are already operational. 3. How you resolve conflicting collision and occlusion files. 4. How you verify conversion and test every supplied map location. 5. Your delivery schedule for the qualification batch, remaining groups and final combined test. 6. That you have reviewed the inventory and can complete the agreed scope for USD 500, with any exclusions stated before acceptance. Relevant experience and verifiable results are required. Generic bids will not be considered.
