title: DPDP Consent Platform Technical Project Lead
description: Hiring: Freelance Project Manager & Technical Expert – DPDP Consent Management Platform Engagement Type: Freelance / Contract Project: DPDP Compliance & Consent Management SaaS Platform Location: Remote Experience: 5+ years preferred in product development, project management, or privacy technology Project Overview We are developing Privafocus, a consent management platform designed to help organisations comply with India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023. We are looking for an experienced freelance Project Manager with strong technical expertise in consent management, privacy compliance, and SaaS product development. The resource should be capable of providing technical guidance, conducting product demonstrations, validating product functionality, and supporting our development team in building an enterprise-ready solution. Key Responsibilities 1. Product Demonstration & Technical Expertise - Conduct detailed demonstrations of consent management and privacy compliance platforms. - Explain end-to-end consent management workflows, including consent collection, recording, withdrawal, and audit trails. - Demonstrate DPDP compliance functionalities such as notices, purposes, data principal rights, grievance management, and privacy dashboards. - Explain real-world implementation scenarios and enterprise use cases. 2. Project Management & Product Development - Work closely with our development team to define product requirements and functional specifications. - Prepare user stories, acceptance criteria, product workflows, and development roadmaps. - Support sprint planning, task prioritisation, and milestone tracking. - Review developed features and validate them against business and compliance requirements. - Identify product gaps and recommend practical solutions. 3. Technical Architecture & Integration - Provide guidance on consent management platform architecture and SaaS product development. - Advise on APIs, SDKs, database integrations, website integrations, and third-party systems. - Support integration planning for cookie consent, email consent, WhatsApp consent, and enterprise applications. - Guide implementation of role-based access control, audit logging, consent evidence, and multi-tenant architecture. 4. DPDP Compliance Expertise - Understand the DPDP Act, 2023, and applicable rules and implementation requirements. - Map legal and compliance requirements to product features and technical controls. - Advise on consent notices, specific purposes, consent records, withdrawal mechanisms, and demonstrable compliance evidence. - Help ensure that product functionality aligns with applicable legal requirements. 5. Product Review & Knowledge Transfer - Conduct periodic product demonstrations and technical review sessions. - Review existing modules and identify functional or architectural gaps. - Provide actionable recommendations and implementation guidance. - Prepare technical documentation and support knowledge transfer to the internal team. Required Skills & Experience - Experience in consent management platforms, privacy technology, or data protection solutions. - Strong understanding of DPDP Act requirements and consent lifecycle management. - Experience in SaaS product development and technical project management. - Knowledge of REST APIs, databases, system integrations, and cloud-based architectures. - Ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications. - Experience with platforms such as OneTrust, TrustArc, Cookiebot, Didomi, or similar solutions is preferred. - Excellent communication and demonstration skills. Expected Deliverables 1. Initial product assessment and gap analysis. 2. Detailed demonstration of consent management workflows and industry best practices. 3. Product requirements and functional specifications. 4. Technical architecture and integration recommendations. 5. Development roadmap with prioritised features and milestones. 6. Periodic product reviews and technical guidance. 7. Documentation and knowledge transfer to the development team. Engagement Model The engagement can begin with an initial paid discovery and demonstration phase, followed by ongoing part-time or milestone-based support, depending on project requirements. Interested freelancers should share: - Relevant experience in consent management or privacy compliance products. - Examples of similar products or implementations they have worked on. - Their proposed approach to product assessment and technical guidance. - Availability, hourly rate, or fixed-price proposal. Important: We are looking for a hands-on professional who can demonstrate real product workflows, provide practical technical expertise, and guide our development team—not just someone who offers theoretical consulting. To Apply: Please share your profile, relevant project experience, and proposed engagement model.

title: HTML 3D Game Unity Port
description: I already have a fully-playable HTML game that uses custom 3 D models, and I want the entire experience reproduced inside Unity. The goal is to keep the same gameplay, levels, and controls exactly as they are now, simply shifting the technology so I can publish on multiple stores. At the moment players interact through touch buttons and swipe gestures, so the Unity build must honour that control scheme without changes. Please begin by delivering an Android-ready build for phones and tablets; once that is confirmed we will move on to iOS and Windows PC exports. You will receive the HTML source, all 3 D assets, and art. I need you to: • Recreate every scene, UI element, and mechanic in a current LTS version of Unity • Optimise shaders, lighting, and textures for smooth mobile performance (60 fps target on mid-range devices) • Implement the existing touch control layout natively in Unity’s input system • Provide one signed, store-ready .apk plus the full, clean Unity project so I can generate iOS and PC builds later I’ll test against the original web game; acceptance is a side-by-side match for behaviour, level flow, and controls. Let me know your timeline and any questions about the asset hand-off.

title: B2B E-commerce Growth with Meta Ads
description: I'm seeking a skilled Meta digital marketer to work closely with me (founder) and my Shopify Gold Partner to help set up and train me to benefit from a Shopify - Meta integration. The goal is to increase repeat purchases from existing customers for my B2B e-commerce business and to grow Insta followers and enhance conversion through social media and advertising on meta. My store is powered by SHopify, and I use Instagram to raise awareness. We use Omnisend and Shopify for order automation emails and marketing automations, but the nature of it requires close customer account management. My clients are very hard to reach, so I want to use Whats App to reach them to encourage quarterly reordering and alert them on new season stock. But I also want to raise awareness and increase conversion rates for both our DTC site and B2B site with social media, influencer, affiliate and Meta ads where ROAS worthwhile. Key Objectives: - Develop and implement targeted Meta ad strategy and educate me on Zeely for future campaigns from photo and video stock. - Leverage CRM tools to identify and engage existing customers - not to replace Shopify and Omnisend's marketing automation but more to work on developing relationships with customers and importantly prompt the quarterly reorder. - Utilize data analytics to measure and optimize campaign performance and grow customer base. Ideal Skills and Experience: - Proven experience in B2B e-commerce marketing. - Expertise in Meta advertising and Meta CRM Whats App systems. - Strong analytical skills and data-driven mindset. - Ability to deliver detailed project proposals. Please submit your detailed project proposals. Looking forward to your submissions! I'd like to put an emphasis on teaching me as part of this work to help me know how to do this going forward.

title: Rhino Model Drawing Set
description: I already have the building massed up in Rhino (.3dm) and now need that model translated into a complete drawing package. Your task is to place the model on its site and prepare a coordinated set that includes a site plan, ground-floor plan, first-floor plan, two sections and one isometric / perspective view. The drawings must be architectural-grade: show doors, windows, stair runs, basic furniture blocks and clear dimensions so the set is immediately presentation-ready. I will supply the Rhino file along with the site CAD underlay; if you need any other export formats (DWG, DXF) just let me know. Please return: • Vector PDFs of each sheet • The editable source files (Rhino and/or AutoCAD) - site plan - ⁠ground floor - ⁠first floor - ⁠2 sections - ⁠isometric (perspective) On auto cad and shi Because my submission deadline is fast approaching, I’d like an initial pass within 48 hours and the final version shortly after any comments. title: SaaS MarTech Tracking & AI Automation
description: # MarTech & Performance Marketing Setup for SaaS (GA4, GTM, Google Ads, Meta Ads, AI Automation) **Budget:** €800–1,500 fixed price **Timeline:** Approximately 2–3 weeks **Project type:** One-time implementation, with potential ongoing collaboration **Location:** Worldwide ## About the business We are a Spanish SaaS platform for livestock farmers. Users can register for free, connect their livestock data, receive a productivity and herd management diagnostic, and upgrade to a paid subscription. We have a public website and a separate web application, built using modern low-code/AI-assisted development tools, including Lovable. We are looking for a hands-on MarTech specialist to implement a simple, reliable, scalable marketing measurement and automation system. Our goal is to test paid customer acquisition through Google Search, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Display and retargeting, using controlled advertising budgets. ## Scope of work **1. Analytics and conversion tracking** - Audit existing Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Google Ads and Meta configurations. - Configure/fix GA4 and Google Tag Manager. - Ensure attribution works across our marketing website and SaaS application. - Implement and validate consent management and Google Consent Mode v2, respecting EU privacy requirements. - Implement conversion tracking for the complete customer funnel: - Website visits by traffic source and campaign. - Clicks on "Free Diagnostic" / "Create Account". - Registration started and completed. - Livestock data connection completed. - First diagnostic completed. - Pricing or subscription checkout initiated. - Paid subscription activated. - Prefer reliable application/backend events for meaningful conversions, especially subscriptions. - Avoid duplicate conversions and unnecessary tracking of personal data. **2. Google Ads and Meta Ads** - Review or configure Google Ads and Meta Business Manager integrations. - Set up conversion actions, campaign tracking and retargeting audiences. - Prepare an initial Google Search and Meta acquisition structure. - Configure Display/retargeting where audience size and consent allow. - Recommend a simple campaign naming convention and UTM structure. - No advertising spend or campaign launch without our approval. **3. Reporting and dashboard** Build a simple Looker Studio dashboard showing: - Traffic and new users by channel. - Marketing spend, CPC and CTR. - Landing-page-to-registration conversion. - Registration-to-activation conversion. - Paid subscriptions and attributed revenue. - Cost per registration, activation and paying customer. - Funnel conversion rates by channel/campaign. **4. AI-powered marketing operations** We want the system to be easy to operate with AI tools rather than require an expensive agency. Please propose a lightweight solution using tools such as n8n, ChatGPT/OpenAI APIs, Google Ads reporting integrations or similar. Minimum requirement: - Automated weekly marketing performance report. - AI-generated insights and suggested campaign improvements. - Simple documented workflows that a junior marketing operator can maintain. - Human approval for any campaign or budget modifications. We prefer reliable, low-cost tools over complex enterprise MarTech platforms. **5. Documentation and handover** - Deliver a tracking/event specification and implementation documentation. - Test the full conversion funnel end to end. - Provide a simple operating guide. - Record a walkthrough and deliver one handover session. - All accounts, tracking assets, code/configuration and dashboards must remain under our ownership. ## Ideal candidate - Strong hands-on expertise in GA4, GTM, Google Ads and Meta Pixel/CAPI. - Experience tracking conversion funnels in SaaS or subscription businesses. - Familiarity with Lovable, SPAs, modern web applications and backend conversion tracking. - Experience with n8n and AI-powered reporting workflows. - Comfortable collaborating with our AI-assisted development workflow (Codex/Lovable) for application changes. - Able to explain technical choices clearly and avoid unnecessary complexity. ## How to apply Please include: 1. Two examples of comparable SaaS tracking or MarTech implementations. 2. Your proposed technology stack, especially for AI automation. 3. How you would track a user from ad click to paid subscription across two subdomains. 4. Your fixed-price quote, expected timeline and exclusions. 5. What you would need from our development team. Please start your proposal with **"CROTALIA TRACKING"** so we can distinguish tailored proposals from generic applications. We are not looking for social media content creation, SEO services or a large agency retainer. The priority is a working measurement, advertising and AI-assisted marketing operations system.

title: Full KNX Home Automation Plan
description: I am in the early construction phase of a new house and want every core system to run on KNX. The brief is straightforward: design, configure and help me bring online a single, integrated network that handles lighting and blinds, heating and air-conditioning, plus the full security layer of sensors and alarms. You will begin with a complete wiring and topology plan that my electrician can follow without guesswork. From there I need the full device list and ETS project file, followed by remote or on-site commissioning support so we can test, tweak and sign off every function. Programming should cover typical scenes (day, night, away, vacation), energy-efficient HVAC logic, and alarm responses that link to lighting and push notifications. Deliverables • KNX wiring & topology diagrams in PDF/DWG • Detailed bill of materials with exact KNX part numbers • ETS project file with all group addresses, parameters and scenes pre-programmed • Step-by-step commissioning checklist and two live support sessions (video or on-site, as agreed) • As-built documentation and a brief user guide for the homeowner Acceptance criteria: the system must pass functional tests for each controlled domain, show stable operation for 48 continuous hours, and allow future expansion through unused group addresses clearly noted in the documentation. If you have a proven track record with ETS, KNX Secure, and multi-discipline integration, I’m ready to review your proposal and timeline.

title: Dynamic Background Replacement Specialists
description: I have a series of moving-camera shots featuring people and props that need complete background replacement. The foreground action must stay untouched while every trace of the original setting disappears, so clean masking, precise rotoscoping, and rock-solid motion tracking are critical. You’ll receive the raw clips and the new background plates; your job is to composite them so they look as though they were shot that way, matching perspective, lighting, grain, and color. Please highlight your experience doing full-scene swaps in After Effects (Rotobrush 3.0, Mocha Pro, 3D Camera Tracker, or equivalent tools). Links to before/after samples where you have replaced entire environments in moving shots will help me gauge fit. Deliverables • Final 4K (or source-resolution) renders with seamless composites • Clean matte passes for all keyed subjects • Organized After Effects project files with linked assets Edges must stay sharp without chatter, tracks must hold through the whole take, and there should be no visible spill or haloing. If this sounds routine for you, let’s talk and schedule a quick test shot.

title: Virtual Operations & Platform Assistant
description: Summary Virtual Operations & Platform Assistant for a Music Licensing Platform Remote | Ongoing freelance opportunity We’re a growing music licensing platform looking for a proactive, organised all-rounder to help manage the day-to-day running of the business. You’ll be the central operational contact connecting customers, music partners, developers and our internal team. We need someone who takes ownership, identifies problems, follows work through to completion and suggests practical improvements. You will report to and support the Business & Operations Manager, who sets priorities, approves workflow changes and oversees business performance. You will own assigned day-to-day tasks, maintain accurate records, coordinate follow-ups and escalate issues outside agreed procedures or authority. You don’t need to be an expert in every area from day one. Your initial responsibilities will reflect your experience and our priorities, with guidance on our platform, policies and specialist workflows. You should already have strong organisational skills, sound judgement and experience managing work independently. Responsibilities Platform and catalogue management - Support day-to-day platform operations and follow up assigned issues. - Upload and manage tracks, releases, audio files, artist information, descriptions and metadata. - Check catalogue accuracy, file quality and required approvals before publication. - Maintain records of agreements, rights information and usage restrictions supplied or approved by management. - Coordinate approved catalogue corrections, replacements and removals. Licensing and Content ID administration - Process routine licensing requests using approved terms and procedures. - Maintain accurate licence records and customer usage information. - Ensure customers receive the correct files, licence documentation and usage guidance. - Coordinate allowlisting/whitelisting requests, Content ID claims and related enquiries. - Track supporting evidence, case references, deadlines and outcomes. - Escalate unclear rights questions, disputed claims and requests outside established policies. Customer support and commercial enquiries - Handle enquiries, subscriptions, refunds, cancellations and account closure requests within agreed policies. - Coordinate the resolution of account, payment, licensing and download issues. - Keep customers informed until their enquiries are resolved. - Respond to commercial enquiries, follow up leads and prepare standard proposals. - Prepare and follow up standard proposals using approved pricing and terms; refer negotiations to the Business & Operations Manager. Publisher, distributor and artist communication - Communicate with publishers, distributors, artists, producers and other music partners. - Follow up missing assets, metadata, documentation and outstanding actions. - Coordinate catalogue delivery and operational queries relating to rights and Content ID. - Prepare usage and revenue reports where required by partner agreements, with financial calculations subject to review. Website management and testing - Coordinate with our web developers, document bugs clearly and follow up fixes. - Regularly test registration, subscriptions, payments, licensing, downloads and account functionality using agreed test procedures. - Check new features and verify that reported problems have been resolved. - Suggest improvements to usability, functionality, design and automation. - Escalate urgent technical issues and obtain approval for changes involving additional spending or significant scope. Task management and meetings - Create, update and track tasks in ClickUp, following priorities, owners and deadlines agreed with the Business & Operations Manager. - Follow up outstanding actions and flag blockers early. - Arrange Google Meet calls, prepare agendas where needed and record decisions and action points. - Turn meeting outcomes into tasks and track them through to completion. Finance administration and reporting - Maintain organised records of income, invoices, receipts, expenses, payments and refunds. - Reconcile records against available transaction reports using agreed procedures and flag discrepancies. - Prepare supporting information for the accountant or finance team, including records needed for VAT returns. - Provide regular updates on sales, subscriptions, licences, customer support, Content ID cases, website issues, finances and outstanding work. This is an administrative finance responsibility. Tax treatment, filings, financial approvals and specialist accounting decisions remain with management and the accountant or finance team. Systems and general administration - Draft and maintain SOPs, checklists, templates and internal documentation, with workflow changes approved by the Business & Operations Manager. - Keep spreadsheets, documents, inboxes and business records organised. - Identify recurring problems, suggest improvements and implement agreed changes. - Learn colleagues’ responsibilities and provide cover as the team grows, while maintaining clear ownership of each area. What we’re looking for - Relevant experience in operations, platform administration, project coordination or a similarly varied role. - Strong written and spoken English. - Excellent organisation, attention to detail and dependable follow-through. - Confidence working with spreadsheets, online systems and structured records. - Professional communication with customers, partners and technical teams. - Ability to prioritise competing requests and work independently. - Willingness to handle routine administration alongside problem-solving and process improvement. - Good judgement about when to act, ask questions or escalate. - Careful handling of confidential customer, commercial and financial information. Experience with **ClickUp, subscription platforms, music licensing, Content ID, digital distribution, customer support, website testing or finance administration** would be valuable. You do not need experience in every area, but please distinguish work you have managed independently from areas where you would need training. Major legal matters, significant financial decisions, high-value deals and strategic decisions remain with management. What success looks like Customers receive timely, clear responses. Catalogue and licence records remain accurate. Claims, bugs and outstanding tasks have clear owners and follow-ups. Financial records are organised for review. Management receives reliable updates without having to chase routine work. How to apply Please include: 1. A brief summary of your relevant experience, including operations you have personally owned. 2. Which parts of this role you could manage independently from the start and which would require training. 3. An example of a problem you identified proactively and followed through to resolution. 4. The tools and platforms you have used. 5. Your hourly rate, weekly availability, time zone and earliest start date. Please also answer this scenario: A customer reports a Content ID claim, another cannot download a licensed track, and a developer is overdue on a payment-related fix. What information would you gather, how would you prioritise the work, and how would you track each issue through to resolution?

title: Mechanical Design Engineer: 4-color retractable pen mechanism (3D-printed prototype)
description: I’m developing a larger-than-normal version of the classic BIC 4-colour pen and need a functional prototype for further development. The job is to take my detailed specs (spring rates, hole sizes, tolerance notes—shared after NDA) and turn them into a working mechanism that reliably locks and releases each colour. Scope • Model the full mechanism plus an outer body that lets me swap refills without dismantling the whole unit. • Produce STEP and STL files. • 3D-print the parts, assemble, and fine-tune until every push button clicks in, stays locked, and pops back smoothly. • Document the build with clear photos and a short video showing all four colours engaging and disengaging. • Optionally ship the prototype to me—let me know cost and carrier options. What I’d like to know from you 1. Examples of similar spring or push-button mechanisms you’ve designed. 2. Your in-house 3D-printer type and the materials you’d use for both housing and moving parts. 3. Separate pricing for design and for printing/testing, plus estimated turnaround. 4. Shipping availability and cost to my location (details on request). The emphasis during testing is on rock-solid lock/release action for each colour; comfort and refill access are secondary but still important. If you enjoy precision mechanical design and hands-on prototyping, I’d love to hear how you’d tackle this challenge.

title: Office 2D Layout & Electrical Plan
description: My second–floor office is roughly 310 sq ft and I already know where every workstation, chair and storage unit should go. What I still need is a clean 2-D drawing that captures: • All furniture in its final positions • Electrical information: lights, fan and AC points with their respective switches clearly marked • Two alternative spots for a compact dry pantry, each annotated with power points for a microwave, induction cook-top and kettle I can share the first-floor CAD/PDF file we used earlier; the new level follows the same column grid so you can trace walls and openings quickly. During a short Teams or Zoom call I’ll walk you through the exact second-floor footprint, confirm dimensions and answer any last questions before you start. Deliverables • Scaled 2-D plan (PDF + original DWG/AI) showing furniture, electrical points and both pantry options, each option labeled for easy comparison • A legend or brief note set so electricians know what every symbol represents • One round of minor tweaks after I review the first draft If you work in AutoCAD, Revit, Illustrator or a similar tool that lets me keep an editable file, that’s perfect. Accuracy, tidy line-work and clear labels are what matter most; the aesthetic “look” has already been decided.

title: Dạy Hệ Thống Solar BESS
description: Tôi muốn triển khai một khóa học kỹ thuật điện chuyên sâu về hệ thống điện mặt trời kết hợp lưu trữ pin (BESS) dành cho sinh viên cao đẳng và đại học. Tôi cần một giảng viên có kiến thức vững vàng, giàu kinh nghiệm thực tế, sẵn sàng thiết kế và giảng dạy toàn bộ nội dung. Phạm vi mong đợi: • Xây dựng đề cương chi tiết: mục tiêu học tập, thời lượng từng chương, tiêu chí đánh giá. • Soạn slide, bài giảng và bài tập thực hành minh họa quy trình tính toán, chọn thiết bị, bố trí tấm PV, cấu hình bộ biến tần, BMS, an toàn tiếp địa. • Lồng ghép ví dụ thiết kế trên các công cụ phổ biến như AutoCAD Electrical, PVSyst hoặc ETAP. • Thực hiện giảng dạy trực tiếp (Zoom hoặc tương đương) hoặc ghi hình bài giảng, kèm file nguồn để tôi có thể tái dụng cho các lớp sau. • Hỗ trợ phần hỏi-đáp, chấm bài, và hiệu chỉnh tài liệu dựa trên phản hồi sinh viên trong suốt khóa học. Tiêu chí hoàn thành: 1. Đề cương và toàn bộ học liệu phải được duyệt trước khi giảng. 2. Nội dung phải bám sát thực tế thiết kế, lắp đặt và vận hành hệ Solar-BESS theo tiêu chuẩn IEC và quy định Việt Nam hiện hành. 3. Bài giảng rõ ràng, dễ theo dõi; minh họa trực quan; có bài tập cuối khóa kiểm chứng năng lực sinh viên. Nếu bạn có kinh nghiệm giảng dạy kỹ thuật điện, đặc biệt trong mảng năng lượng tái tạo và BESS, hãy gửi cho tôi bản giới thiệu ngắn gọn về kinh nghiệm, chứng chỉ và ví dụ tài liệu bạn từng xây dựng. Tôi sẽ ưu tiên người đã từng làm dự án thực tế hoặc giảng dạy cho đối tượng sinh viên kỹ thuật.
contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40787856, publicado hace 3 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 15 - 25.

title: Monthly Kids YouTube Animation Production
description: I run a fast-growing children’s YouTube channel and need a reliable animator who can turn my ideas into 15 engaging videos every single month. Quality and punctuality matter just as much as creativity, because the schedule is ongoing. Most months I provide a brief—sometimes a complete script, other times just a concept—and rely on you to handle the rest: storyboards, character and background design, animation, basic SFX, and the final render. Whether you prefer Adobe Animate, After Effects, Toon Boom, Blender, or another tool, I’m flexible as long as the end result is colourful, kid-friendly, and ready for upload. Deliverables • Fifteen finished MP4 videos each month, 1920 × 1080 resolution with clean stereo audio • Editable project files and separate asset folders for archiving and localisation • Rolling schedule: 5 videos by the 10th, 5 by the 20th, 5 by month-end The channel’s style may shift—sometimes simple 2D cartoons, other times more dimensional or mixed media—so adaptability is a plus. Show me two or three links to your most relevant children’s work, tell me the software you use, and confirm you can sustain this volume long-term. I’m excited to build a long-running partnership that keeps kids smiling month after month.

title: Especialista en Contenido Estratégico para Redes Sociales de Agenci...
description: Imarketics, es una agencia de marketing digital con 8 años de trayectoria y más de 50 proyectos exitosos en Barranquilla, busca un/a comunicador/a de contenidos digitales. No se requiere un Community Manager de alcance completo, sino un profesional enfocado en planificar, crear, publicar y optimizar el contenido para nuestras redes sociales: Instagram, Facebook y TikTok. El objetivo principal es resolver la desconexión entre nuestra sólida trayectoria y la imagen actual de nuestras redes sociales. Actualmente, nuestro Instagram está desactualizado, carece de publicaciones recientes y reels, y su estética no refleja la modernidad ni la experiencia de nuestra agencia. Además, no muestra al equipo detrás de Imarketics ni está optimizado para búsquedas locales como 'agencia de marketing digital en Barranquilla'. Queremos que nuestras redes reflejen la experiencia y el profesionalismo de una firma con más de 8 años en el mercado. El enfoque estratégico esperado prioriza la autoridad y la confianza, dado que nuestro público objetivo son dueños de negocio y gerentes de marketing. Buscamos: - Autoridad con trayectoria real: Comunicar de manera efectiva nuestros años de experiencia, casos de éxito y resultados comprobables. - Rostro humano sin sobrecargar al equipo: Generar contenido recurrente que presente a las dos personas que conforman el equipo de la agencia. - Contenido educativo B2B: Crear piezas breves y claras que aborden temas relevantes para nuestro público, como 'qué es un embudo de ventas' o 'cómo elegir entre SEO y pauta paga'. - Redes como puerta de entrada, web como cierre: El contenido en redes sociales debe generar reconocimiento de marca y dirigir tráfico calificado a nuestro sitio web, donde se concretan las oportunidades de negocio. Alcance del trabajo: Actualización y optimización de biografía, imagen de perfil y estética en Instagram, Facebook y TikTok (una vez, al inicio). Incluye una biografía de Instagram optimizada para búsqueda local. Benchmarking local inicial frente a 3–4 agencias de referencia en Barranquilla. Diseño y propuesta de una parrilla y un calendario de contenido mensual para aprobación previa. Producción y publicación de 12 publicaciones mensuales (posts estáticos y carruseles, 3 por semana). Producción y publicación de 3 a 4 reels/TikToks al mes, con posibilidad de escalar a ritmo semanal según resultados. Reporte mensual simple de desempeño (alcance, interacciones, crecimiento). Sesión inicial de definición de identidad visual actualizada. Categoría: Marketing Digital y Ventas Subcategoría: Community Management ¿Qué necesitas?: Pocas publicaciones por semana o marca en crecimiento

title: Metin2 | Multiplayer Geliştirme, Hata Giderme, Performans Optimizasyonu ve Yük Testleri
description: PC, Android ve iOS platformları için geliştirdiğimiz, gerçek zamanlı çok oyunculu bir MMORPG projesi için deneyimli bir Senior Multiplayer / Game Developer arıyoruz. Projemiz geliştirme sürecinin ileri aşamasındadır. Temel oyun sistemlerinin büyük bölümü tamamlanmış ve 60'tan fazla fonksiyonel test senaryosu başarıyla sonuçlandırılmıştır. Sıfırdan oyun geliştirilmesini istemiyoruz. Mevcut kaynak kodlarını analiz ederek multiplayer sistemini tamamlayabilecek, bütün kritik hataları giderebilecek, mobil ve sunucu performansını optimize edebilecek ve oyunumuzu ticari lansmana hazırlayabilecek bir geliştirici arıyoruz. Aradığımız kişinin geliştirme, hata giderme, optimizasyon ve test süreçlerinin tamamını üstlenebilmesi gerekmektedir. 1. Multiplayer Geliştirme Mevcut multiplayer mimarisinin incelenmesi, tamamlanması ve iyileştirilmesi. Client-server iletişiminin ve gerçek zamanlı senkronizasyonun optimize edilmesi. Oyuncu hareketleri, savaşlar, animasyonlar, yetenekler ve etkileşimlerin senkronizasyonu. Ağ trafiği, paket işleme, gecikme ve bant genişliği optimizasyonu. Multiplayer hatalarının, bağlantı kopmalarının ve senkronizasyon sorunlarının giderilmesi. Güvenilir yeniden bağlanma mekanizmalarının geliştirilmesi. PC ve mobil istemcilerin aynı multiplayer altyapısıyla sorunsuz çalışmasının sağlanması. Sunucu taraflı doğrulama, güvenlik ve eşzamanlı işlem problemlerinin çözülmesi. 2. title: Part Drawing & Model Scraper
description: I have a list of part numbers and need an automated way to pull their drawings directly from a public manufacturer website. For every part number the script must: • Locate and download the 2D drawing and the 3D model available on the product page. • Save the 2D drawing as a clean PDF and the 3D model in its native CAD format (whatever the site provides—STEP, IGES, etc.). • Store each pair of files in an organised folder structure that mirrors the part-number list so I can locate anything quickly later. The scraper should run headlessly, cope with pagination or login-free search boxes, and pause intelligently so it is not blocked. Please include basic error handling to skip parts that have no drawings and log them in a report. Deliverables 1. Well-commented source code (Python preferred, but I’m open). 2. A brief README explaining setup, required libraries, and how to point the script at a fresh CSV of part numbers. 3. Output sample showing at least three downloaded parts with correct file formats. If you’ve tackled similar scraping jobs—especially for engineering content—let me know; I’ll prioritise proven solutions.

No assets from FS games, other mods, other games or paid libraries without a license. I receive the full rights to use, change and publish the model as a free FS25 mod. Credit to you is welcome. Payment and schedule I would like to pay in stages: rough model, finished model with texture, final export and acceptance. Please state your fixed price and delivery time.

title: Urgent JPEG-to-Mailchimp Template
description: I have a finished promotional design saved as a high-resolution JPEG and I need it translated into clean, responsive HTML that Mailchimp accepts as a reusable template. The layout includes hero imagery, a few supporting graphics, and clearly defined call-to-action buttons. Those visual elements can stay fixed, but every line of copy must remain editable inside Mailchimp’s drag-and-drop editor so I can refresh wording for future sends without touching code. The build has to render flawlessly in Gmail and Apple Mail on both desktop and mobile. Please keep the code lightweight, comment your sections, and follow Mailchimp-friendly best practices (inline CSS, table structure, no external stylesheets). Deliverables • One HTML file ready for direct upload to Mailchimp • Any supporting assets (optimised images, if you slice them) in a tidy folder • Quick test screenshots or a short screencast proving it displays correctly in Gmail and Apple Mail Time is tight, so let me know how soon you can turn this around once I hand over the JPEG.

title: Interior realistic Render with D5/Corona
description: I need a photorealistic render of an interior space and I am open to using D5 Render, Corona, or V-Ray—whichever lets you achieve the most convincing materials, lighting, and mood in the shortest time. All modelling is already done; your focus will be scene setup, texturing, lighting, camera work, and final post-production. Turnaround is urgent, so please indicate how quickly you can deliver the first draft and the final, polished images. When you bid, include links or attachments that show past interior work rendered in any of the engines above; this is the single most important factor in my decision. Deliverables I expect: • 2–3 high-resolution stills (4K minimum) showcasing the space from key angles • Source file(s) in the engine you use • One round of minor tweaks after I review the first delivery If you are confident you can hit a realistic look fast, I’m ready to start right away.

title: Closer de Servicios de Alto Valor
description: Si sabes vender, igual esto te interesa ! Buenas, voy al grano. En ViralBee vendemos páginas web y posicionamiento en Google a empresas. Nada especialmente raro. Hay negocios que necesitan más clientes, nosotros les ayudamos a conseguirlos y alguien tiene que venderlo. Ahí entras tú. Buscamos comerciales que sepan moverse, hablar con empresarios y cerrar ventas. Gente que prefiera salir a vender antes que pasarse el día hablando de vender. ¿Y qué hay para ti? Pues comisiones de entre el *25 % y el 40 % por venta*. Los servicios que vendemos están entre los *1.500 € y los 2.500 €*. Haz números. Una venta puede dejarte entre *375 € y 1.000 € de comisión*, dependiendo del importe y del porcentaje que tengas acordado. Y no, no necesitas venderle una web a tu primo, a tu cuñado ni a tu vecino el del quinto. La idea es trabajar con negocios y empresas que puedan necesitar nuestros servicios. Si tienes experiencia como comercial, eres closer o simplemente sabes vender y crees que puedes cerrar operaciones, me gustaría hablar contigo. Sin entrevistas eternas. Sin historias raras. Hablamos, te cuento cómo funciona y vemos si tiene sentido para los dos. *Si te interesa, escríbeme* Y si conoces a alguien que sea bueno vendiendo, pásaselo. Igual le acabas de alegrar el mes. Un saludo, *ViralBee*

title: Asesor Comercial Corporativo B2B
description: Busco un asesor comercial experimentado que pueda hacerse cargo de todo el ciclo de ventas: • Conseguir nuevos clientes • Atender y cerrar ventas con clientes interesados • Gestionar cuentas y fidelizar clientes actuales El foco será prospectar y desarrollar relaciones con pequeñas, medianas y grandes empresas. Para lograrlo, necesitarás combinar llamadas telefónicas, videollamadas, correo electrónico y reuniones presenciales según convenga a cada oportunidad. Qué espero de tu trabajo: 1. Generar un flujo constante de prospectos calificados. 2. Convertir oportunidades en ventas con un proceso claro de seguimiento. 3. Mantener y ampliar las cuentas existentes, identificando oportunidades de upselling y cross-selling. 4. Reportar semanalmente el estado del pipeline, métricas de conversión y acciones próximas. Valoro la experiencia previa en entornos B2B, un estilo de comunicación persuasivo y autonomía para organizar tu propia agenda. Si dominas CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho o similar) y tienes historial demostrable de cumplimiento de cuotas, será un plus. Indica en tu propuesta: • Resultados comerciales alcanzados en los últimos 12 meses. • Sectores o nichos donde tengas mayor red de contactos. • Herramientas de ventas que manejas. Estoy listo para empezar de inmediato y evaluaré candidaturas con base en experiencia y plan de acción.

title: Wikipedia Page Corrections & Updates
description: I need an experienced Wikipedia editor to bring my existing page fully up-to-date and factually accurate. The priority is fixing several incorrect dates, titles, and names that have crept in over time. I can supply official documents and public records for every correction, so you will have verifiable, citable sources at hand. Scope of work • Review the current article line-by-line, highlighting each date, title, or name that conflicts with the documentation I provide. • Update the text and infobox accordingly, adding precise citations that satisfy Wikipedia’s reliable-source policy. • Ensure all edits comply with neutrality, notability, COI, and other Wikipedia guidelines so the changes stick. • Where space allows, polish wording and structure for clarity without altering tone. • Submit the revised wikitext and an edit summary I can paste directly, or, if you have an established editor account in good standing, make the live edits yourself. Success criteria • Every corrected fact matches the supporting document. • References are formatted properly and link to the primary record. • No warnings, reverts, or flags within one week of publication. If you have a solid track record of successful Wikipedia contributions and understand the platform’s policies inside and out, I’d love to hear how you would approach this update and your estimated timeline.

title: Asterisk-Zoiper AWS Configuration
description: Necesito que Asterisk quede funcionando en un servidor Amazon Web Services y que Zoiper en Android se registre sin problemas. El escenario es sencillo pero debe quedar completamente operativo: • Tipo de llamadas: entrantes y salientes usando números telefónicos reales. • Extensiones simultáneas: entre 1 y 5 en Zoiper para Android. • Proveedor de telefonía: ya dispongo de los números, pero aún no cuento con los datos de conexión; por eso requiero tu ayuda para seleccionar o configurar correctamente el troncal (SIP o IAX) que garantice buena calidad y tarifas competitivas. Al finalizar espero: 1. Instancia AWS debidamente asegurada (puertos, firewall, NAT) con Asterisk actualizado y estable. 2. Dialplan configurado para llamadas entrantes y salientes, grabación opcional y buzón de voz básico. 3. Creación de las extensiones, credenciales y QR de aprovisionamiento para Zoiper en Android. 4. Configuración del troncal con el proveedor elegido, pruebas de llamada y registro de calidad. 5. Breve guía en español con los pasos esenciales por si necesito añadir más usuarios o cambiar números. Con todo listo, podremos marcar y recibir desde los móviles de inmediato.

Prefiero un archivo PSD totalmente editable, con todas las capas bien organizadas y tipografías incrustadas o indicadas. title: Posicionamiento SEO Web Semana Santa
description: Quiero mejorar la visibilidad de mi portal de noticias dedicado a la Semana Santa en toda la provincia. Mi prioridad es aparecer en los resultados de Google cuando la gente busque información sobre la Semana Santa provincial, no solo en la capital sino en cada municipio donde se celebran procesiones y actos relacionados. El sitio (Wordpress) ya publica —y seguirá publicando— principalmente: • Noticias y actualidad de hermandades y procesiones • Horarios, itinerarios y mapas de recorridos Busco una estrategia SEO integral que incluya: 1. Auditoría técnica del sitio para detectar y corregir problemas que limiten el rastreo o la velocidad. 2. Investigación de palabras clave específicas de Semana Santa, segmentadas por municipio y por tipo de búsqueda (noticias, horarios, recorrido). 3. Optimización on-page: meta-titles, descripciones, encabezados, enlazado interno y datos estructurados para eventos. 4. Plan de contenidos evergreen y de temporada que complemente mis artículos actuales y refuerce la autoridad temática. 5. Estrategia de enlaces de calidad desde portales locales, blogs cofrades y medios religiosos. 6. Reportes mensuales con métricas clave: posiciones, clics, impresiones y oportunidades de mejora. Valoraré experiencia previa posicionando medios locales o páginas sobre fiestas religiosas, así como el dominio de herramientas como Google Search Console, Ahrefs o Semrush. Mi meta es notar avances tangibles antes de la próxima Cuaresma, con tráfico creciente y presencia estable durante todo el año.

title: Diseño integral libro de fantasía
description: Estoy preparando el tercer volumen de una saga épica y necesito un artista que se ocupe de todo el apartado visual del libro. Los dos primeros fueron publicados por una editorial (Atlantis Ediciones) que ha quebrado y he recuperado los derechos de autor. Para los tres tomos necesito: • Portada completa (frontal, lomo y contraportada) lista para impresión y versión e-book, reflejando un estilo mágico y detallado. Relación visual entre los tres libros y una evolución oscura. • 3 Mapas de mi mundo. Los tengo hechos "de mala manera". Puedo facilitarlos para que sirvan de punto de partida. debe leerse bien tanto a página completa como en blanco y negro: Mundo completo, Un archipiélago de islas y una isla en concreto. • Pequeños diseños interiores: encabezados de capítulo, viñetas, separadores y algún motivo decorativo que mantenga la coherencia estética con la portada y el mapa. Busco ilustraciones ricas en texturas y luces, con atención al detalle y a la atmósfera fantástica. Aporto sinopsis, referencias visuales y bocetos de la geografía para facilitar el trabajo. Entregables deseados: – Arte final en alta resolución (300 dpi) en PSD/AI con capas organizadas y PDF listo para imprenta. – Archivos optimizados para Kindle/EPUB. – Versiones en escala de grises para impresión económica. Flujo propuesto: bocetos iniciales, una ronda de ajustes mayores y pulido final. Si la colaboración funciona, contaré contigo para posibles ediciones especiales y, ojalá, para el cuarto y quinto volumen. ¡Espero tu propuesta y muestras de trabajos similares!

title: Diseño y maquetación de web corporativa en Wordpress con Elementor V4
description: Somos QMS Calidad, una consultoría de certificación ISO en Madrid (calidad, medio ambiente, seguridad y salud en el trabajo). Queremos rehacer el diseño de nuestra web, qmscalidad.com , que hoy está en WordPress con el tema Astra y Elementor. Qué te damos hecho: El mapa de la web, con las páginas y el objetivo de cada una. Todos los textos, ya escritos y revisados. Las fotos seleccionadas. El logotipo y los colores de la casa. Qué necesitamos de ti: Una propuesta de diseño de la portada y de una página de servicio. Elegimos una y sobre esa sigues. La maquetación de unas 10 páginas en Elementor V4 (elementos atómicos, no los widgets clásicos), con estilos y colores globales, para que luego podamos cambiar los textos sin romper el diseño. Que se vea bien en el móvil y cargue rápido. Todo en borrador: la web actual sigue publicada hasta que aprobemos la nueva. Condiciones: Trabajas con un usuario de WordPress que te creamos para el proyecto. No hace falta acceso al alojamiento. No usamos Elementor Pro. Si alguna parte lo necesita de verdad, dínoslo en tu propuesta y lo valoramos. No cambies plugins ni ajustes de la web sin preguntarnos antes. Si necesitas algún plugin nuevo, que sea compatible con PHP 8.4, que es la versión en la que irá la web. Pago por hitos: propuesta de diseño, maquetación completa y correcciones finales. En tu propuesta, cuéntanos: Dos o tres webs que hayas hecho con Elementor V4 (enlaces). Cuánto tardarías y tu precio por el proyecto completo. Cuántas rondas de correcciones incluye. Categoría: Programación y Tecnología Subcategoría: Programación Web ¿Cuál es el alcance del proyecto?: Cambio mediano

title: Editor/a Vídeo Dinámico Redes Sociales
description: Tengo grabaciones ya filmadas y busco a alguien que domine la edición para transformarlas en piezas de unos 5 minutos, ágiles y visualmente potentes, pensadas específicamente para Instagram y TikTok. Trabajo en castellano, así que necesito que te comuniques fluidamente en español y sepas adaptar tono, ritmo y tendencia a una audiencia hispanohablante. No me importa qué software uses (Adobe Premiere, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut, etc.); lo esencial es que el resultado final sea atractivo y mantenga a la audiencia enganchada. Entregables principales: • Video final optimizado para formato vertical 9:16, listo para publicar en Instagram Reels y TikTok. • Versión sin marcas de agua ni logotipos ajenos. • Archivo fuente o proyecto editable para ajustes futuros. Para evaluar compatibilidad, empezaríamos con un primer video. Si quedo satisfecho, habrá encargos regulares. Incluye en tu propuesta enlaces directos a trabajos similares o tu portfolio online. ¡Nos vemos en la bandeja de entrada!

title: Edición creativa de vídeos sociales
description: Grabaré piezas de unos cinco minutos hablando directamente a cámara y necesito que tú las transformes en clips capaces de captar la atención en Instagram, TikTok y otras redes. Busco un estilo rápido y enérgico: cortes ágiles, efectos llamativos y un ritmo que mantenga la vista pegada a la pantalla. Para reforzar el impacto, quiero incorporar: • Palabras destacadas y subtítulos que se muevan con la voz • Música y efectos de sonido que marquen el tempo • Transiciones fluidas y algunos apoyos visuales (imágenes o pequeños inserts) cuando el discurso lo pida Yo entregaré el metraje crudo y cualquier indicación clave sobre tono o mensaje. Tú devuelves un archivo optimizado para vertical (1080 × 1920) listo para publicar, color corregido, con audio balanceado y todos los elementos sincronizados. El primer encargo será un único vídeo; si encajamos, la idea es seguir colaborando de forma continua. Trabaja desde donde quieras. Envíame enlaces a dos o tres de tus mejores ediciones que muestren ritmo, creatividad y buena narrativa visual.

title: Logotipo elegante para marca
description: Necesito un logotipo elegante y profesional para una tienda / marca de productos. Quiero que combine el nombre de la marca con un símbolo o icono que refuerce la identidad visual y comunique confianza y calidad. Lo que busco • Estilo: Elegante y profesional, sin recargar detalles innecesarios. • Formato: Nombre de la marca acompañado de un símbolo o icono distintivo. • Versatilidad: El diseño debe funcionar igual de bien en etiquetas, empaques, web y redes sociales, tanto en color como en versión monocromática. • Originalidad: Solo se aceptarán propuestas 100 % originales; nada de plantillas genéricas. Entregables • Archivos vectoriales editables (AI o SVG). • Versiones en PNG y JPG a 300 dpi. • Breve guía de uso que indique tipografías y paleta de colores. Valoraré detalles como la armonía tipográfica, la legibilidad a distintos tamaños y la capacidad del icono para reconocerse incluso sin el texto. ¡Espero ver tu mejor concepto!

Vi su requerimiento relacionado con **Experto en Marketing Digital para Generar Ventas en Empresa de Limp...** y me pongo a su entera disposición:

🔩 **4. Cubiertas Mixtas en Guadua y Metal**: Techos resistentes con anclajes metálicos soldados para proteger la estructura de la humedad.

title: Diseño CAD de Silla Salvaescaleras
description: Se solicita un profesional con experiencia en ingeniería mecánica, estructural y diseño CAD para desarrollar el diseño de una silla salvaescaleras de concepto original, destinada a viviendas unifamiliares o multifamiliares, con una carga nominal objetivo de 160 kg. El diseño deberá priorizar la seguridad, ergonomía, funcionalidad, estética moderna y modularidad, permitiendo futuras modificaciones y adaptación a diferentes configuraciones de escaleras. Entregables: Modelo 3D del conjunto y componentes. Planos generales y detalles técnicos. Especificaciones preliminares de materiales, uniones y tolerancias. Propuesta de rieles, soportes y sistema de fijación. Lista de materiales y componentes comerciales. Esquema funcional del accionamiento y controles. Criterios preliminares de cálculo y seguridad. Identificación de riesgos y plan de pruebas. Guía básica de montaje y mantenimiento. Estimación de costes de fabricación. Formatos: PDF y archivos CAD editables, preferentemente STEP y DWG, según corresponda.
